stories.title: Youth assault case: three arrested from Kuttiyadi hideout; two have prior criminal cases
Young woman's body recovered from burning pyre:Father claims daughter was killed by partner, had been in live-in relationship for five years
stories.summary: Police in Agra recovered the body of a young woman from a burning funeral pyre on Wednesday. The woman had been living in a live-in relationship for the past five years. She was a Muslim, while the man she lived with is Hindu. After her death, the man took the body for cremation, but police arrived on receiving a complaint. The girl’s father claimed, “My daughter was not killed by natural causes. She was murdered. The accused had eloped with my minor daughter five years ago, and they had been living together since. Today, he has killed her and was attempting a secret cremation.” The incident took place around noon in Jajau village of Kirawali. Background of the relationship Nizam, a resident of Kirawali, said his daughter Sana (21) had been living with Ajit Singh in a live-in relationship for five years. Ajit Singh works in finance and frequently visited their home. When Sana was still a minor, Ajit allegedly lured her away. Since then, she had been living with him in Jajau village. On Wednesday afternoon at around 3 pm, Sana passed away. Cremation carried out without informing family Ajit Singh, along with villagers, took Sana’s body to the local cremation ground for last rites. Meanwhile, her family filed a murder complaint with Fatehpur Sikri police station. The police team arrived at the cremation ground, where the pyre was already burning. The police extinguished the pyre and sent the body for post-mortem. Ajit Singh was taken into custody on the spot for questioning. Father alleges murder Sana’s father, Nizam, said, “Ajit Singh used to visit our home for installments. At that time, he lured my minor daughter away. Later, he even converted her religion. After some time, he started torturing her and physically abusing her. My daughter has been murdered.” Police statement and investigation Kirawali Inspector Anand Veer Singh said the accused claims that the woman had been unwell for some time and died of illness. However, her father has accused Ajit Singh of murder. The police have initiated a thorough investigation, considering the minor’s elopement, alleged marriage, religious conversion, and the circumstances of her death. Kirawali Inspector Anand Veer Singh said- The accused party says that the young woman had been sick for some time. She died due to illness. A post-mortem of the body was conducted to determine the cause of death. The young woman's father has alleged murder. A serious investigation is being conducted regarding taking her away as a minor, alleged marriage, religious conversion and cause of death.

stories.title: Yogi govt focuses on women voters:₹18,000 crore earmarked for education, skills and jobs; here’s what the election-year budget offers you
stories.summary: In the election year, the Yogi Adityanath government has placed women at the centre of its ₹9.12 lakh crore Budget for FY 2026–27, allocating ₹18,620 crore for schemes focused on girls’ education, safety and skill development. The budget provides: To strengthen women’s safety, the government has announced: The government has also proposed opening 12 new ITIs exclusively for women. Additionally, 47 out of 286 existing ITIs will have dedicated women’s wings. While ₹400 crore had been allocated earlier for a scooty distribution scheme for girls, the vehicles are yet to be distributed. Farmers get relief: Irrigation, seeds and stray cattle Farmers have been offered multiple relief measures in the budget. To address fertilizer shortages, ₹150 crore has been allocated for advance stocking. Under the Seed Park Development Project, ₹251 crore has been earmarked, alongside the introduction of the Uttar Pradesh Self-Reliant Seed Policy, aimed at enabling farmers to produce their own seeds. The government will spend ₹18,290 crore on irrigation and flood control. Major projects such as: are expected to bring irrigation to 4.49 lakh hectares of land. To tackle the issue of stray cattle, ₹2,000 crore has been allocated. Farmers caring for cattle will now receive ₹50 per animal per day, up from ₹30, directly into their bank accounts. Currently, 1.13 lakh farmers are managing 1.81 lakh cattle under the scheme. The government is also constructing 155 large cow protection centres, with ₹100 crore proposed for the initiative. Under the Chief Minister Krishak Samriddhi Yojana, ₹38 crore has been allocated to subsidise interest on long-term agricultural loans. For the Chief Minister Farmer Accident Welfare Scheme, which supported 18,144 families last year, ₹1,150 crore has been allocated this year. Mobile veterinary units have also been introduced for the first time under the Centre’s Livestock Health and Disease Control Scheme. Youth and Employment: Skill, industry and investment The government has significantly increased its focus on skill development and employment generation. Employment and industrial growth will be driven by: The textile sector alone is expected to generate 30,000 jobs. Under the Chief Minister Gramodyog Employment Scheme, 800 units will receive ₹40 crore in bank loans, with a target of creating 16,000 new jobs. Defence corridor and Data centres: Big investment plans The Defence Industrial Corridor has already signed MoUs for 200 defence industries, expected to attract ₹35,280 crore in investment and generate over 53,000 direct jobs. The state is also pushing digital infrastructure: Letters of comfort have been issued for eight projects — six data centre parks and two standalone units. So far, ₹21,342 crore has been invested, creating 644 MW capacity. Thousands of skilled professionals are expected to be employed in the sector. Education and Infrastructure expansion The budget also proposes: Middle class: Indirect relief While the middle class did not receive direct tax relief, the government has attempted to provide indirect support through investments in healthcare, infrastructure and new housing schemes.

stories.title: Husband kills wife over her dark skin:Victim strangled at home, electric shock applied to stage death; family alleges repeated abuse since marriage
stories.summary: In Jhansi on Wednesday, a 23-year-old woman, Pooja Pal, was strangled to death by her husband, Dheeraj Pal. Her brother said that Pooja was repeatedly taunted for her dark complexion and threatened with a second marriage. He added that her husband is lying, claiming she died from an electric shock. According to the brother, when family members reached the house in Palinda village under Raksa police jurisdiction, Pooja’s body was lying outside. There were two rope marks on her neck, injuries on her face, and burn marks on her left hand. The post-mortem report confirmed that Pooja was strangled to death. Three years of marriage, constant harassment Sunil Baghel, Pooja’s brother from Andora village in Datia, said Pooja was their only daughter. She had married Dheeraj Pal, a farmer from Palinda village, on 22 April 2022. The couple had a two-year-old daughter. Her brother said that since the beginning of her marriage, Pooja had been harassed. Her husband repeatedly told her she was dark-skinned and said he would marry another woman. The in-laws also demanded ₹5 lakh and a car. Pooja had informed her family about the harassment. On two occasions, relatives went to her in-laws’ house, after which Dheeraj promised not to trouble her. But harassment resumed, and three days ago, Pooja reported another incident of beatings. Family receives call about electric shock The brother said that around 4:30 am on Wednesday, the family received a call from the in-laws claiming Pooja had died due to electric shock. When they arrived, her body was outside the house. The rope marks on her neck were visible, her head had multiple injuries, and her left hand bore burn marks. Sunil Baghel said Pooja had been strangled, and the electric shock was staged to cover up the murder. Post-mortem confirms strangulation Since the couple had been married for three years, a magistrate conducted an inspection, and two doctors performed the post-mortem. The report confirmed Pooja had been strangled to death. Her neck had two circular marks, her face had injuries, and her left hand had a burn mark. The body was later handed over to the family. CO Sadar Ramvir Singh said- The case is being investigated. A case will be registered upon receiving the complaint. There are injury marks on the deceased's neck. Family members have accused the husband of murder. Currently, the husband is absconding.

stories.title: UP Evening Wrap:‘Vande Mataram’ to play before ‘Jana Gana Mana’; 14 new medical colleges, 3 universities plan announced in UP Budget more
stories.summary: Bhaskar English brings you the biggest news from Uttar Pradesh and around the world. Here are the top news headlines of the day: 1. Nirmala Sitharaman speaks in LS after Rahul Gandhi slams Budget The discussion on the Union Budget is continuing in Parliament. Rahul Gandhi addressed the Union Budget in the Lower House. Rahul Gandhi said that the United States relies heavily on Indian data to maintain its technological supremacy. 2. Girls to receive ₹1 lakh for marriage now: 14 new medical colleges, 3 universities plan announced in UP Budget The Uttar Pradesh government has presented its biggest-ever election budget, with a total outlay of over Rs 9.12 lakh crore. The budget places special focus on girls’ welfare, medical infrastructure and employment. The Finance Minister announced that new schemes worth Rs 43,000 crore have been introduced. The state will open 16 new medical colleges and three universities. 3. Retired sub-inspector found hanging from fan with wife: Bodies found hanging from separate nooses The bodies of a retired police inspector and his wife were found hanging inside their house in Meerut. The incident came to light when the maid arrived for housework on Wednesday morning. The incident occurred in the Rakshapur area adjacent to Ganganagar. Here in Sector-4, UP Police retired officer Chaudhary Lallu Singh lived with his wife, Santosh. 4.‘Vande Mataram’ to play before ‘Jana Gana Mana’ The Ministry of Home Affairs has issued new guidelines regarding the National Song 'Vande Mataram'. According to the new rules, all people will be required to stand in honour whenever 'Vande Mataram' is played at any government event, government school programs, or other formal gatherings. 5. Ashutosh Maharaj alleges child abuse at Avimukteshwaranand’s camp:Files case in court, presents 2 alleged victims Sexual exploitation of minor children takes place in Shankaracharya Swami Avimuktheshwaranand's camp. They abuse children under the guise of gurukul. They are involved in illegal activities. They have assets beyond their income. An impartial investigation should be conducted. These serious allegations against Avimuktheshwaranand, who came into discussion after the dispute at Magh Mela, have been made by Ashutosh Brahmachari Maharaj. He filed a complaint in the Special POCSO Court of Prayagraj on February 8. In support of his allegations, he also produced 2 minor victim children. 6. Meerut businessman’s wife funeral carried out on wedding anniversary A dairy businessman's wife from Meerut died in a road accident in Rajasthan. She had gone to visit Udaipur with her family after darshan at Khatushyam. She got off the bus to visit the Shrinathji temple near the highway. That's when a speeding trailer hit her. The woman got stuck in the front part and was dragged. Her body was torn into pieces. Flesh pieces were scattered on the road for about 50 meters. Her daughter came running on the highway and kept crying while holding her mother's body. She kept calling out "Mommy-Mommy" repeatedly. 7.US deletes map showing PoK, Aksai Chin as Indian territory The US Trade Representative’s office removed a social media post that showed a map of India including the entire Jammu and Kashmir region, Pakistan-occupied Kashmir (PoK), and the Aksai Chin area as part of Indian territory. 8. Lamborghini case takes dramatic U-turn:Complainant changes stance, driver surrenders in court A dramatic U-turn unfolded on Wednesday in the high-profile Kanpur Lamborghini accident case. The man claiming to be the driver surrendered before a court in the afternoon, while the complainant, Mohammad Tausif, reached a compromise in the matter. Accompanied by his lawyer, Tausif appeared in court and stated that the Lamborghini was being driven by Mohan, not Shivam Mishra — the businessman’s son who was earlier accused. 9. ‘Terror accused’ Abdul Rahman buried in Ayodhya; inmate kills him in sleep inside Faridabad jail The body of 20-year-old Abdul Rahman was buried in a graveyard in Ayodhya amid emotional scenes, as nearly 200 villagers attended his funeral prayers. As his bier was lifted, his mother and sister broke down in grief, with his mother reportedly fainting while crying. After offering Namaz, he was buried in a cemetery located about 500 meters from his home in Manjanai village. 10. Mohsin Naqvi wanted Bangladesh to get 'respect' in boycott row Pakistan Cricket Board (PCB) chairman Mohsin Naqvi said that his aim was for Bangladesh to 'get some respect' in the boycott controversy, which dominated headlines in the T20 World Cup 2026. Pakistan had, on 1 February, announced that they will boycott the match against India on 15 February.

stories.title: UP Budget 2026 Live: यूपी बजट 2026 में क्या हुआ सस्ता और महंगा? इन चीजों के रेट में बड़ा बदलाव, देखें पूरी लिस्ट
stories.summary: Uttar Pradesh Budget 2026 Live Updates: यूपी बजट 2026 का 9 लाख 12 हजार 696.35 करोड़ रुपए है। वित्त मंत्री सुरेश खन्ना ने बुधवार को यूपी बजट 2026-27 पेश करने जा रहे हैं। यूपी बजट 2026 को लेकर पूरे पद्रेश की नजरें हैं। उत्तर प्रदेश का बजट 2026-27 अब तक का सबसे बड़ा है, जिसमें कुल 9.12 लाख करोड़ रुपये का प्रावधान किया गया है। यह पिछले साल से करीब 13% अधिक है। हालांकि राज्य बजट में सीधे टैक्स स्लैब या कई वस्तुओं पर बड़े बदलाव नहीं हैं, लेकिन केंद्र के यूनियन बजट 2026 के असर से यूपी के लोगों पर कई चीजों के दाम प्रभावित होंगे। केंद्र ने कस्टम ड्यूटी, TCS और अन्य टैक्स में बदलाव किए हैं, जिससे कुछ चीजें सस्ती और कुछ महंगी हो सकती हैं। यूपी में रहने वाले मरीजों, आम उपभोक्ताओं और यात्रियों को इसका सीधा फायदा या नुकसान होगा। आइए विस्तार से देखें।

stories.title: 'I’ll gouge your eyes out':Mau railway parcel superintendent threatens RPF constable after parcel dispute; video surfaces online
stories.summary: A railway parcel superintendent allegedly abused and threatened an RPF constable in Mau, even warning he would gouge out his eyes while declaring his name and post. In Bhojpuri, he is heard saying My name is Rajesh Singh, Parcel Superintendent Mau... Will take out your eyes... You don't know how to talk... A 1 minute 45 second video of the February 10 incident at the railway parcel office has surfaced. In the clip, the RPF jawan repeatedly asks him to speak properly, while the superintendent continues shouting threats, hurling abuses and acting aggressively. The RPF constable has been identified as Amit Kumar Yadav, posted in Chhattisgarh. However, officials later intervened and got both sides to reach a compromise. What the superintendent is heard saying In the video, a man wearing spectacles is seen threatening a युवक. He identifies himself as Mau parcel superintendent Rajesh Singh and loudly repeats his name and designation while threatening to gouge out the constable’s eyes within two minutes. He says, “You don’t know who you’re talking to. Before your parcel, you will be dispatched.” He is also seen using abusive language. He repeatedly states his name and caste in the clip and threatens that he could take out the constable’s eyes within minutes. Argument over parcel in office Amit Kumar Yadav, originally from Mau but posted in the RPF in Chhattisgarh, reached the railway parcel office around 4.30 pm Tuesday to book a parcel. It is said the parcel was open. Superintendent Rajesh Singh asked him to get it packed, but Amit insisted it be sent as it was, saying he would handle it. This led to a heated exchange. Amit said he was in the RPF and could manage. Rajesh replied he too had spent 15 years in the RPF before being transferred to the parcel department and told him not to lecture him. The argument escalated and Rajesh allegedly lost his temper. Video goes viral after compromise GRP officials said that seeing the commotion, officers reached the spot and called both sides to the office. After hearing them, a compromise was reached. Despite this, the RPF jawan later circulated the video at night, after which it spread rapidly on social media. Users online have also linked the clip to a recent Kanpur HDFC Bank case in which a female employee allegedly threatened a woman customer while invoking her caste. Now know what is the Kanpur HDFC Bank case... A video from the HDFC branch in Panki Sector-2, dated January 6, had shown a female employee, Aastha Singh, threatening customer Ritu Tripathi while mentioning her caste and allegedly trying to hit her with a laptop. Later, Ritu filed a police complaint accusing the employee of misbehaviour and caste-based threats and shared the video online.

stories.title: Fire breaks out at Vrindavan hotel on opening day:Three injured as smoke engulfs building, guests rescued with crane
stories.summary: A massive fire broke out on Wednesday at the newly constructed Siddhi Vinayak Hotel in Vrindavan, Mathura, just hours after its inauguration. Three people sustained severe burn injuries in the incident. The hotel had been formally opened earlier in the day. Within hours, flames engulfed the building, triggering panic across the area. Dense smoke traps guests inside According to officials, thick smoke quickly filled the hotel premises after the fire erupted, leaving several people trapped inside. Rescue teams have launched an intensive evacuation operation, using a crane to bring stranded individuals to safety. Police and fire brigade units rushed to the scene immediately after receiving information. More than six fire tenders are currently engaged in efforts to douse the flames. Authorities have cordoned off the surrounding area and evacuated nearby premises as a precautionary measure. The entire locality has been placed under a security perimeter. See 4 pictures Around 40 people feared trapped Sonu, the nephew of the hotel owner, said the hotel had been inaugurated by his uncle earlier in the day, and the family was present at the venue. “Nearly 40 people are trapped inside. The fire started on the upper floor due to a short circuit. Within moments, it spread across the entire hotel,” he said. Cause yet to be confirmed While a short circuit is suspected to have triggered the blaze, officials have stated that the exact cause of the fire is yet to be determined. Firefighting and rescue operations are ongoing.

stories.title: Ministers caught in candid moments during UP Budget:One dozes, another twirls moustache as Khanna praises BJP, recites poetry and targets SP
stories.summary: Baat anmol bahut hai, ye jindagi ke liye Bata raha hoon falsafa main har kisi ke liye ponch sakte ho to dukhiyon ke ponch lo aansu Na jiye aap fakat apni khushiyon ke liye ( The matter is very precious, for this life, I am telling the philosophy for everyone that if you can wipe, then wipe the tears of the sorrowful people and don't just live just for your own happiness) This couplet was recited by UP Finance Minister Suresh Khanna during his budget speech on Wednesday. Through these four lines, he presented what he described as the working approach of the Yogi government. Khanna presented the budget in 1 hour 17 minutes. He recited six poems and targeted the Samajwadi Party. He spoke six minutes longer than last time. The minister referred to the able leadership of Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath. Excluding scheme names beginning with the Chief Minister’s title, Khanna mentioned CM Yogi seven times. Amid loud desk-thumping, he was seen repeatedly looking toward members and the Chief Minister. Several interesting moments were seen during the speech. Yogi kept reading the budget booklet and tapped his desk at the poetry lines. Minister Narendra Kashyap appeared to doze, while Baldev Singh Aulakh was seen twirling his moustache. The opposition remained silent. Khanna mentioned Uttar Pradesh and the Yogi government’s policies in a poetic style. He began the speech by referring to the state’s all-round development, law and order, employment, women’s empowerment, and the welfare of youth, farmers and the poor. 1- Development of every class and every region- He said that from the first day of his tenure, Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath has worked tirelessly for the development of every section and region of the state, and this has been his resolve: 3- On Ancient Cultural Heritage - He said that during previous governments, ancient cultural and religious heritage was grossly neglected, but now the situation has changed. Under the Chief Minister’s guidance, the state has revived these heritages, generating new employment. You may not change, but the times are changing. A rose blooms on stone, a lamp burns in the storm. 4- On Upliftment of State's Tribes - He said tribal communities were never seriously considered earlier, adding that breaking centuries-old rigidities and giving society a new direction is a demanding task, but vision, determination and tireless effort are making it possible. It is with great difficulty that a morning smiles, While sorrow quietly walks in by evening. Life changes in no time, But it takes a lifetime to bring change. 5- On Yogi Model - He said the government has done commendable work in every sector under CM Yogi’s guidance, which has received positive assessment from top national institutions such as NITI Aayog, the Reserve Bank of India and the CAG. He added that UP’s development and law-and-order situation are being praised widely. Worthy of praise is the style of each task; Uttar Pradesh sings songs in Yogi’s name.

stories.title: ‘Terror accused’ Abdul Rahman buried in Ayodhya:Inmate kills him in sleep inside Faridabad jail; father says, 'He was about to get bail'
stories.summary: The body of 20-year-old Abdul Rahman was buried in a graveyard in Ayodhya amid emotional scenes, as nearly 200 villagers attended his funeral prayers. As his bier was lifted, his mother and sister broke down in grief, with his mother reportedly fainting while crying. After offering namaz, he was buried in a cemetery located about 500 meters from his home in Manjanai village. Rahman was allegedly murdered inside the Faridabad jail on February 8 by a fellow inmate. His family brought his body from Faridabad to their native village, around 650 kilometers away, on Tuesday night. Rahman had been arrested in March 2025 by the Gujarat Anti-Terrorism Squad (ATS) on charges of plotting to blow up the Ram Temple in Ayodhya. Investigators had claimed he was in contact with Abu Sufiyan, a notorious operative of Al-Qaeda in the Indian Subcontinent (AQIS). 'His bail was about to be granted,' says father Rahman’s father, Abu Bakar, said he had met his son on February 5, just days before his death. Abu Bakar said, His bail was likely to be granted soon. When I met him, he told me that a new inmate had been placed in their barrack two or three days earlier. When we asked about his condition, he said everything was fine and that he had no problems. On February 9, the family received news of Rahman’s death. Abu Bakar said they received a call from Faridabad jail around 7:30 AM on Monday informing them that his son had been killed and that he had been struck on the head with a stone. Jail authorities asked the family to reach Faridabad immediately. 'At first, I thought it might be false information,' he said. ‘Then I contacted our lawyer. After he spoke to the concerned authorities and confirmed the incident, we realized the news was true.’ When the family reached Faridabad, police reportedly told them that there was no known enmity involving Rahman inside the jail. Authorities assured them that a thorough investigation would be conducted. Abu Bakar has demanded a fair and impartial probe into the incident. Even jails are not safe Former village head Pawan Yadav said he learned about the incident through media reports. ‘It is extremely serious that a prisoner was killed inside a high-security jail in Faridabad. If inmates are not safe inside jail, it naturally raises questions about security arrangements,’ Yadav said. He further alleged that the incident appeared 'sponsored' and not a routine occurrence. ‘Such an incident inside a high-security prison cannot be considered normal. Security arrangements must be reviewed,’ he added. Rahman’s uncle, Usman, alleged that the administration’s attitude was insensitive. 'They told us to take the body if we wanted to. We were not even allowed to properly examine the body to see where the injury marks were,' he said. Arrest by Gujarat ATS in March 2025 Alleged online radicalisation On Instagram, Rahman continued to upload provocative speeches and videos. His account was reportedly struck down multiple times due to violations. Investigators claim that his online activity brought him to the attention of Abu Sufiyan. Subsequently, he was allegedly radicalized and provided online terror training by AQIS. Due to repeated social media strikes and surveillance inputs, Rahman came under the radar of Haryana STF, Gujarat ATS, and Uttar Pradesh STF, which began tracking him. According to investigators, Abu Sufiyan’s handler had hidden two hand grenades and detonators in a pit in Faridabad. Rahman was allegedly instructed to travel to Ayodhya on April 4, but he was arrested earlier on March 2 by Gujarat ATS and Haryana STF. How the jail murder occurred According to Tigaon ACP Ashok Verma, only three inmates were housed in the security barrack at the time of the incident: Abdul Rahman from Uttar Pradesh, and Arun Chaudhary, and Shoaib Riaz from Jammu Kashmir. Chaudhary and Riaz had been shifted to Neemka jail from Jammu Kashmir for security reasons. Initially, the three were lodged in separate barracks, but about 15 days before the incident, they were placed together in the same high-security barrack. Dispute over Ram temple Jail sources said that tension had been brewing between Rahman and Arun Chaudhary, also known as Abbu Jatt, for nearly 10 days over the Ram Temple issue. Chaudhary was reportedly upset over the construction of the Ram Temple and would often assert that his religion was supreme. Meanwhile, Chaudhary had allegedly come to know that Rahman had been in contact with AQIS operative Abu Sufiyan and had conspired to attack the Ram Temple. This reportedly led to frequent arguments between the two inmates. Attack inside barrack According to jail sources, the incident took place between 2 AM and 3 AM on Monday. At the time, Rahman and Shoaib Riaz were asleep, while Arun Chaudhary was awake. Chaudhary allegedly smothered Rahman’s mouth and repeatedly struck the back of his head with a sharp-edged stone. Hearing the noise, Shoaib Riaz woke up and raised an alarm, alerting security personnel stationed outside the barracks. Within 10 minutes, jail officials arrived. Rahman was rushed to the jail hospital but was declared dead. Weapon prepared in advance Sources said that after the murder, Arun Chaudhary sat calmly, while Shoaib Riaz appeared frightened and did not attempt to intervene during the attack. It is alleged that Chaudhary had grown increasingly angry over the ongoing disputes regarding the Ram Temple. Earlier that day, he had reportedly sharpened a stone inside the jail premises and kept it ready as a weapon. He allegedly used that stone to strike Rahman multiple times, leading to his death.

stories.title: Retired sub-inspector found hanging from fan with wife:Bodies found hanging from separate nooses; son lives separately with partner
stories.summary: The bodies of a retired police inspector and his wife were found hanging inside their house in Meerut. The incident came to light when the maid arrived for housework on Wednesday morning. The incident occurred in the Rakshapur area adjacent to Ganganagar. Here in Sector-4, UP Police retired officer Chaudhary Lallu Singh lived with his wife, Santosh. They had hired a maid for housework. Their son lives separately with his wife, while their daughter is married in Punjab. Son was living separately for a year The retired inspector's son, Sandeep, had been living separately with his wife in Gangadham Colony for a year. He arrived after neighbors informed him. According to neighbors, the husband and wife did not maintain much contact with anyone. They would occasionally talk to people while coming and going. They spent most of their time inside the house. Forensic team collected evidence.. Based on the neighbors' information, the police team sent the bodies of the couple for a post-mortem. The forensic team collected evidence from the house and investigated the facts. Police have also questioned the retired inspector's son. IPS (Under Trainee) Bajrang Prasad said- Both bodies have been sent for post-mortem. Something can be said only after the post-mortem report. No suicide note has been found. Currently, police are investigating at their level.

stories.summary: The Uttar Pradesh government has presented its biggest-ever election budget, with a total outlay of over Rs 9.12 lakh crore. The budget places special focus on girls’ welfare, medical infrastructure and employment. The Finance Minister announced that new schemes worth Rs 43,000 crore have been introduced. The state will open 16 new medical colleges and three universities. He also declared that financial assistance for daughters’ marriage will be increased from Rs 50,000 to Rs 1 lakh. An allocation of Rs 100 crore has been made for the development of Ayodhya. Additionally, Rs 800 crore has been earmarked for the development authorities of Meerut, Mathura-Vrindavan and Kanpur. A sum of Rs 2,374 crore will be spent on providing free tablets and smartphones to students. The state will establish an AI Mission, with a provision of Rs 225 crore. The government has promised to provide employment to 10 lakh youth. Rs 400 crore has been allocated to distribute scooties to girl students.

stories.title: Ashutosh Maharaj alleges child abuse at Avimukteshwaranand’s camp:Files case in court, presents 2 alleged victims; complaint filed under POCSO act
stories.summary: Sexual exploitation of minor children takes place in Shankaracharya Swami Avimuktheshwaranand's camp. They abuse children under the guise of gurukul. They are involved in illegal activities. They have assets beyond their income. An impartial investigation should be conducted. These serious allegations against Avimuktheshwaranand, who came into discussion after the dispute at Magh Mela, have been made by Ashutosh Brahmachari Maharaj. He filed a complaint in the Special POCSO Court of Prayagraj on February 8. In support of his allegations, he also produced 2 minor victim children. The court issued notice to Avimuktheshwaranand and questioned him. Two days later, on February 10, Avimuktheshwaranand's lawyer filed a reply. In this, allegations have been made against Ashutosh Maharaj. Now on February 20, lawyers from both sides will appear in court. After hearing both sides, the judge can order an FIR or dismiss the case. Ashutosh Brahmachari is a disciple of Jagadguru Rambhadracharya, the Peethadhishwar of Shri Tulsi Peeth in Chitrakoot. He is also the main petitioner and party in the Sri Krishna Janmabhoomi versus Shahi Mosque Idgah case. After the dispute in the Magh Mela, Rambhadracharya and Avimukteshwaranand came face to face. First complained to Police Commissioner, then went to court On January 24, 6 days after the Mauni Amavasya dispute, Ashutosh Maharaj filed 2 complaints against Avimukteshwaranand with the Prayagraj Police Commissioner. In the first complaint, it was alleged that minor children are kept in Avimukteshwaranand's camp and gurukul. They are made to do personal service, gather crowds, events and palanquin-related work. There is also suspicion of sexual exploitation of children in this. Children were made to work in large events like Magh Mela, which could be a violation of child rights and labor laws. The camp should be investigated for suspected illegal weapons, assets exceeding income, and multiple bank accounts. The complaint also demands investigation into the role of a person named Mukundanand. In another complaint, Avimukteshwaranand is accused of creating fake letterheads and documents. It states that in the Magh Mela area, Avimukteshwaranand, claiming to be the Shankaracharya of Jyotish Peeth, is sending letters to administrative officials using letterheads and documents in the name of "Jyotish Peeth/Sri Shankaracharya Camp". These letterheads and letters are fake and misleading, which is deceiving the administration and general public. These letterheads bear the date January 24, 2026 (Magh Shukla Panchami). Letters have been issued using this date in the name of "Sri Shankaracharya Camp", whose validity has been questioned. Read what happened on Mauni Amavasya On January 18, during the Magh Mela on Mauni Amavasya, Avimukteshwaranand was going to bathe in a palanquin. The police stopped the palanquin of Shankaracharya Swami Avimukteshwaranand. Police asked him to walk to Sangam. Shankaracharya's disciples did not agree and started moving forward with the palanquin. On this, a scuffle broke out between the disciples and the police. Police had taken several disciples into custody. Police had also beaten a sadhu at the police post. This angered Shankaracharya and he insisted on getting the disciples released. Officials tried to reason with him, folded their hands, but he did not agree. After this, police took several more supporters of Shankaracharya into custody. Shankaracharya's palanquin was pulled and taken 1 km away from Sangam. During this, the canopy of the palanquin also broke. Shankaracharya could not even take his bath.

stories.title: Lamborghini case takes dramatic U-turn:Complainant changes stance, driver surrenders in court; police probe based on CCTV and witnesses implicates Shivam
stories.summary: A dramatic U-turn unfolded on Wednesday in the high-profile Kanpur Lamborghini accident case. The man claiming to be the driver surrendered before a court in the afternoon, while the complainant, Mohammad Tausif, reached a compromise in the matter. Accompanied by his lawyer, Tausif appeared in court and stated that the Lamborghini was being driven by Mohan, not Shivam Mishra — the businessman’s son who was earlier accused. Mohan told the court that he was driving Shivam Mishra’s car at the time of the accident. He claimed Shivam had suffered a seizure, causing panic inside the vehicle. “I got nervous and couldn’t understand what to do. That’s when the accident happened,” Mohan said. He added that after the car’s window was broken and the door opened, he slipped out from below, while a bouncer pulled Shivam out of the vehicle. He said he stood aside after the crash and Shivam was later taken away in another car. “We all know how to drive,” he added. Complainant seeks no further action Shivam Mishra’s lawyer, Narendra Kumar Yadav, said that the injured complainant had reached a settlement with the driver. “The complainant has identified Mohan as the person driving the car. He has also stated that he does not wish to pursue any further action in the case,” the lawyer said. Father accuses police commissioner of lying On Tuesday afternoon, the case took another twist when Shivam’s father, businessman K.K. Mishra, arrived at Gwaltoli police station. He claimed that his son was not driving the Lamborghini at the time of the accident. According to K.K. Mishra, the driver Mohan was behind the wheel while Shivam was asleep. He further alleged that the car locked automatically after the accident, worsening his son’s health. “When he recovers, I will personally bring my son to the police station,” Mishra said. When asked about the Police Commissioner’s earlier statement that Shivam was driving, Mishra responded, “The Police Commissioner is lying.” Meanwhile, the family’s lawyer claimed that Shivam was unconscious and admitted to a hospital in Delhi. Police investigation contradicts family’s claims However, police sources said that K.K. Mishra’s claims have been found to be false during the investigation. According to officials, CCTV footage, eyewitness accounts and other key evidence clearly establish that Shivam Mishra was driving the Lamborghini at the time of the accident. The probe also indicates that no other person or driver was present inside the car when the crash occurred. Police maintain that the accident was caused by Shivam himself and that the investigation is continuing despite the reported compromise. First know 5 major pieces of evidence in police investigation report 1.) Video of accident revealed truth Police have included a video in their investigation after the accident. In this, after the accident, bouncers come from another car following the Lamborghini. They break the Lamborghini's window with a brick to open the gate. They pull Shivam out from the Lamborghini's driver's seat. They take him to the hospital in another car. Police claim that Shivam can be clearly seen being pulled out from the driver's seat. The video clearly shows that there was no other person in the car. This is why they had to break the window with a brick and only then could open the car door to get Shivam out. 2.) Statements of more than 10 eyewitnesses recorded The second biggest evidence in the police investigation report is the statements of eyewitnesses. Inspector Dinesh Singh, who is investigating the case, has recorded statements of more than 10 eyewitnesses. During questioning, all of them stated that Shivam Mishra was driving the car. There was no other person present in the car. After the accident, bouncers took him out of the car. All eyewitnesses have dismissed claims about a driver operating the vehicle or any other person being present in the car. Police have recorded statements of all these eyewitnesses in their investigation report. 3.) Shivam's mobile location found at accident site To strengthen their claim further, police have included Shivam's mobile location as electronic evidence in their investigation report. During the accident, Shivam's mobile location was also at the accident spot on VIP Road. 4.) Entire incident captured on CCTV Police have also obtained CCTV footage from cameras installed by the Municipal Corporation under the Smart City project in their investigation report. The entire accident was captured in the CCTV footage obtained from the Municipal Corporation's control room. Police have included this as crucial evidence in their investigation report. This footage also clearly shows that there was no driver in the car, only one person was present. This is the strongest evidence that proves the claim of accused Shivam Mishra's father KK Mishra to be false. 5.) Complainant also identified Shivam in his statement Statements have been recorded of Mohammad Taufiq, resident of Chamanganj Ghusiana, who filed the FIR for the accident. In his statement, the complainant said that there was only one person on the driver's seat in the Lamborghini car. After watching the video, he confirmed that accused Shivam Mishra was driving the car. The complainant's statement is considered most important in any case. The complainant's statement has also been included in the investigation report as important evidence in the entire case. Police will present investigation report in court today DCP Central Atul Kumar Srivastava said - The Lamborghini car is registered in Shivam Mishra's name. A petition has been filed in court by Shivam's lawyer to release the car. Along with this, a surrender petition has been filed by driver Mohan. Today, Gwaltoli police station will present the investigation report in court. The police investigation report clearly shows that Shivam was driving the car. Police have found sufficient evidence in their investigation. There is also electronic evidence. After this, the court will make its decision. Although a surrender petition has been filed by the driver in this case, the FIR is registered under bailable sections. 6 people were hit by Lamborghini, know the full case On February 8 afternoon, a speeding Lamborghini hit 6 people on VIP Road. In the case, police filed an FIR based on the car number after receiving a complaint from injured Mohammad Taufiq, resident of Chamanganj Ghusiana. Although there was live video footage of the accident along with other important evidence, police only registered the case based on the car number due to the influence of the billionaire businessman. When SP chief Akhilesh Yadav and others questioned the police's working style for giving relief to the accused in a high-profile case, the police hastily added the name of car driver Shivam Mishra to the FIR 24 hours after the accident on February 9. On February 10, accused Shivam Mishra's father KK Mishra reached Gwaltoli police station to record his statement, claiming that their driver Mohan was driving the car while his son was sitting in it. He also mentioned that due to his son's ill health, Shivam could not come to record his statement but would do so soon. However, police investigation revealed that the claims made by accused Shivam's father KK Mishra and their lawyer Dharmendra Singh were completely false, but now it remains to be seen whose claims will hold up in court.

stories.title: Man falls from 100-foot mobile tower in Kannauj, video surfaces:Says, ‘Get me married or I’ll jump’; wanted to marry girlfriend
stories.summary: In Kannauj, a young man fell from a 100-foot-high mobile tower. The young man sat on top of the tower for 2 hours. He was saying - Marry me, otherwise I will jump and die. People were trying to convince the young man who had climbed the tower when, suddenly, he lost his balance. He couldn't control himself and fell to the ground. People rushed him to the hospital. According to doctors, his condition remains serious. This incident on Wednesday took place in Purabhoj village, under the Gursahaiganj police station area. The young man has been identified as Sumit Rajput (18). It is being said that he was having an affair with a relative's daughter. Both families did not agree to their marriage. Entire incident in 3 pictures Farmer climbs tower, falls Sumit Rajput, a farmer from Purabhoj village, climbed a mobile tower on Wednesday morning and began shouting a girl’s name, demanding to be married to her. He repeatedly said, ‘Get me married to her, otherwise I will jump and die.’ Hearing the commotion, villagers gathered at the spot, and his family members also arrived. Everyone tried to persuade him. On receiving information, police reached the village and joined efforts to convince him, but he insisted on a promise of marriage, saying he would come down only after it was finalised. Villagers Rajeev Kumar, Anoop Kumar, Pradeep Kumar, and Sanjay Kumar said that despite continuous persuasion by police and family, he did not relent. At around 10 AM, he suddenly lost his balance and fell. He was immediately rushed to the hospital.

stories.title: Shreyas Talpade faces new fraud allegations:Actor and 12 others accused of fake bank investment scam
stories.summary: A complaint has been filed against Bollywood actor Shreyas Talpade and 12 other members in a fraud case. It is alleged that Shreyas Talpade defrauded a person of lakh in the name of investment. According to an ANI report, a complaint was filed against Shreyas Talpade and others at Bhogaon police station in Mainpuri on February 10. The complainant, a resident of Bhogaon, alleges that the actor and his associates defrauded him of millions of rupees by luring him with an investment. According to the complaint, the actor took money from several villagers to open a Mumbai bank branch in Mishrana Mohalla, Bhogaon, and invest in it. However, it later came to light that the bank mentioned was fake. After receiving the complaint, the court has ordered an investigation into the matter. Besides Shreyas Talpade, the complaint also includes the names of Sameer Agarwal, Sania Agarwal, RK Shetty, Sanjay Mudgil, Shabab Hussain, Narendra Negi, Pankaj Agarwal, Supriya, Anuj Jain, Ajay Srivastava, and Arvind Tripathi. In the complaint, Shreyas Talpade has been described as a marketing advisor. Complaints of fraud have been filed against Shreyas Talpade earlier Before this case, Shreyas Talpade's name had also come up in a fraud case in the year 2025. Last year, Babli from Mitli village had filed a complaint against 22 people, including Shreyas Talpade and Alok Nath, for a multi-crore fraud. It was alleged that he was the brand ambassador of a company that had defrauded 500 people by luring them with the promise of doubling their money. Also in 2025, Shreyas Talpade's name had surfaced in a chit fund case, and complaints were registered against him in Uttar Pradesh, Uttarakhand, and Haryana.

stories.title: Tiger kills 65-year-old woman in Pilibhit:Body discovered 200 metres away from home in forest; flesh missing from stomach and neck
stories.summary: A 65-year-old elderly woman was killed by a tiger in Pilibhit. The woman had gone into the forest for some work. That's when a tiger hiding in the bushes attacked. It grabbed her throat in its jaws and took her into the dense forest. Family members found the woman's body in the forest just 200 meters away from the colony in the morning. The flesh from the woman's stomach and throat was missing. The tiger had broken her neck bone. There were many scratch marks on the body. The surrounding bushes were broken, which clearly shows that the woman struggled with the tiger to save her life. Currently, the forest department and police teams have arrived after being informed by family members. The woman's body has been sent for a post-mortem. The forest department says - so far, no tiger paw prints have been found in the surrounding area, but the death was caused by an attack from some wild animal. The incident occurred in the Mahof forest range of Neuria police station, about 20 kilometers away from the district headquarters. On Wednesday morning, around 7:30 AM, villagers found a mutilated body of a woman in the dense forest ofthe Mahof forest range of Pilibhit Tiger Reserve (PTR). The flesh from the stomach and neck was missing, and there were claw marks of wild animals on the body. The deceased was identified as 65-year-old Parul, who was a resident of Mahof Colony. The colony is just 200 meters away from the incident site. Upon receiving information about the tiger attack, teams from the forest department and police reached the spot. The body was sent for a post-mortem. The forest department investigated the surrounding area, but so far has not found any paw prints of a tiger or other wildlife. Missing since Tuesday evening According to husband Sukumar Rai, Parul went to collect wood in the forest on Tuesday afternoon. When she didn't return for a long time, family members started searching but found nothing. The family informed the police late Tuesday evening. On Wednesday morning, villagers saw a body lying inside the forest in the Bagga beat area and informed the forest department. It is suspected that a tiger hiding in the bushes suddenly attacked the woman and dragged her away after grabbing her in its jaws. Deputy Director says - Wildlife attack, but tiger not confirmed Pilibhit Tiger Reserve Deputy Director Manish Singh said - A woman's body has been found in Bagga beat of Mahof range. Prima facie, the case appears to be a wildlife attack, but the exact cause of death will be clear only after the post-mortem report. The body has been sent for post-mortem. Manish Singh said - The forest department has increased patrolling in the area and has instructed villagers not to go alone towards the forest, especially to remain alert during morning and evening times. Efforts are being made to track the tiger. Villagers said - Tiger had been roaming for many days This incident is near the UP-Uttarakhand border. This area has previously been considered sensitive for human-tiger conflict. After the incident, there is an atmosphere of fear in Mahof Colony and the surrounding villages. Villagers say that tiger movement has been observed for the past few days.

stories.title: Meerut businessman’s wife funeral carried out on wedding anniversary:Daughter says, 'mother stepped out for Shrinathji darshan'; hit by truck, body torn into pieces
stories.summary: A dairy businessman's wife from Meerut died in a road accident in Rajasthan. She had gone to visit Udaipur with her family after darshan at Khatushyam. She got off the bus to visit the Shrinathji temple near the highway. That's when a speeding trailer hit her. The woman got stuck in the front part and was dragged. Her body was torn into pieces. Flesh pieces were scattered on the road for about 50 meters. Her daughter came running on the highway and kept crying while holding her mother's body. She kept calling out "Mommy-Mommy" repeatedly. The accident happened on the Gogunda Pindwara highway in the Badgaon area. On February 10, the woman's body was brought to Meerut, where her last rites were performed. After the accident, Dainik Bhaskar team reached the family. Read the full report… Daughters were asking while crying, what was their fault... Brijmohan Yadav's family lives in Ravindrapuri of Sadar Bazaar in Meerut Cantonment area. He runs a dairy named Banke Bihari. The family includes wife Anita, son Shiva, his wife Shalu, and their sons Saksham and Samarth. Anita's daughters, Shefali and Nidhi, are married. Shefali has a daughter, Pavni, and a son, Yuvan. On February 10, Anita's body arrived at their home in Meerut. The daughters were crying inconsolably. They were only asking - what was mother's fault? She just wanted to have darshan. That trolley driver ruined our home and left. She was everything to this house, now the house is empty. Anita's last rites were performed on the banks of the Ganga at Garh Ganga. Businessman said - Wife used to visit Vrindavan 5-6 times a year Businessman Brijmohan Yadav says - My wife Anita was very religious. She used to do a lot of worship at home too. She would go to Vrindavan-Mathura and Khatushyam for darshan 5 to 6 times a year. This time, too, she was supposed to go for darshan. I have a business, so it's not possible to go frequently. That's why this time she went with daughter Nidhi for Khatushyam's darshan. Daughter said- I just watched, couldn't save mother Anita's daughter, Nidhi, says- We had completed darshan of Khatushyam. Initially, we didn't have plans, then suddenly thought of visiting Udaipur too. We were in a tourist bus. We were traveling on the Gogunda-Pindwara highway in Badgaon area of Rajasthan. The driver stopped the bus near the Shrinathji temple in Ghasiyar. Mother was tired. She didn't get down for darshan. Then the driver himself said when will you come here again? Please take darshan... After this, my mother got out of the driver's side. She must have been just 15 feet away from me when the truck hit her. In this accident, her body was torn into pieces. After the accident, the trailer driver stopped, then fled from the scene after about a minute. Crying, Nidhi said - I could only watch my mother, I couldn't save her. Nidhi says - During the journey, mother had done shopping worth Rs 15,000 for her granddaughter and grandson. She was saying that it's her wedding anniversary, so she would give gifts to everyone. We didn't know that she would meet death, and the family would face this grief. Police searching for driver through CCTV Station Officer Kitab Devi said that the Badgaon police station immediately reached the spot. Post-mortem was conducted with the consent of family members. A report of the accident has been registered. CCTV footage installed on the highway is being examined to trace the absconding trailer. The trailer was orange in color with a Gujarat registration number and was loaded with coal.

stories.title: Ritu Tripathi claims my husband is receiving online threats:'If anything happens, Astha Singh who said 'I am Thakur' will be responsible' adds wife
stories.summary: A verbal war has now started between Astha Singh, who said 'I am a Thakur, I will teach you a lesson...' at HDFC Bank in Kanpur, and Ritu Tripathi, who resigned from the bank. Ritu Tripathi says that Astha has made baseless allegations against my husband. Because of these allegations, people are making online threats to my husband. People are talking about killing my husband. We are scared of the threats. What did my husband do? He had favored his wife. Was it wrong to ask her to leave on time? Think about what Astha is saying. Everything is recorded in the bank's CCTV. When it comes out, everything will be clear. If anything happens to my husband, Astha Singh, who said, 'I am a Thakur, I will teach you a lesson...' will be responsible. I have filed a complaint against Astha Singh on the public hearing portal. I have to stay late in the bank at evening, that's why I resigned Ritu Tripathi told Dainik Bhaskar that I joined HDFC Bank's Panki branch on November 6, 2024. I was asked to go at 11 PM on December 31, 2024, even though I had told everyone there that I have an 8-month-old daughter. I leave her at home. My husband cannot handle her alone. Even after this, I was not let go on time. I was tortured. I was under mental pressure. That's why I resigned. I was taunted about timing. When I was late, branch manager Sumit Singh would ask me why I didn't go with him on joint calls. He would call me to his cabin. When I was late, he would say he'll drop me off. That's why he didn't like my husband coming there. When I refused the branch manager's requests, he would tell me to resign. Ritu's husband said - Being a Brahmin itself is my crime Ritu's husband, Rishi Mishra, said that people make allegations against even the President behind their back. If the bank's CCTV footage is viewed, it will clearly show who misbehaved first. When I learned that my wife and sister were treated rudely, then I reached the bank. Regarding Astha Singh filing a defamation case, he said what is there to complain about? Should I tolerate both the insult and defamation case? It should be directly assumed that being a Brahmin is a sin. If I wanted to make the video viral, I would have done it on January 7 itself. I don't even know from where the video went viral. When I received the video, I shared it with someone. We have filed a complaint against Astha. We cannot do anything else. My only crime is that I am a Brahmin by caste. Just and only because I am a Brahmin, I am being suppressed. I feel that being a Brahmin is a crime in this country. What Astha Singh said, read now Bank relationship manager Astha Singh released a video giving clarification. She folded her hands and said - I did not misbehave with any customer. My dispute was with the husband of a female contract employee of the bank. He asked about my caste and misbehaved with me; that's when I got angry. I still stand by my statement. I am a Thakur, I am proud. The female employee (Ritu Tripathi) had submitted her resignation and demanded immediate relieving that day. During this time, her sister-in-law was present in the branch since morning, with whom there was a minor argument. She said that later, the female employee told this to her husband, who came to the bank after working hours and used abusive language with me. Astha said that the female employee's husband came to my desk, asked about my caste, and spoke threatening words. Astha Singh said, I admit that some of my words could be wrong. Words should be chosen carefully in public service, but threats and insulting language cannot be tolerated. The video has been wrongly presented by making it a casteism issue. Now know what is the complete matter A video went viral on social media on February 8, in which HDFC Bank employee Astha Singh is seen saying - I am a Thakur, I will teach you a lesson. In the video, she can also be seen using abusive language. In anger, she is also seen attempting to attack someone by picking up a laptop. After the video went viral, Astha explained that this video is from January 6, which was made viral after a month.

stories.title: Born dead; large eyes made family believe she was goddess:60 thousand offerings received in Mainpuri, preparations to build temple; Doctor say it was an underdeveloped fetus
stories.summary: 'The Goddess Mother was born...in 9 days, Mother showed 9 forms. First as Kali Maa, then as Durga Maa. Finally, she said before leaving that I am going... please establish my place here.' Radha, wife of Kanchan, is telling this to everyone who comes and goes in Halpura village of Dannahar area in Mainpuri. She claims that the baby girl she gave birth to is a goddess. Before birth, the goddess had revealed everything about herself in a dream. For 13 days now, kirtan (devotional singing) is happening outside their house. Claims of miracles are being made. People are coming from far away for darshan. Offerings worth 60 thousand have been received. Preparations are being made to build a temple. However, the family keeps changing their statement repeatedly. Dainik Bhaskar team reached the village and learned about the situation there. What is the family's claim? What does the delivery doctor have to say? Talked to experts about newborns like this. Read the full report… Radha, wife of Kanchan from Halpura village in Mainpuri, gave birth to a baby girl around 11 AM on January 21, 2026. Family members claim that this was not an ordinary baby, but an incarnation of the Goddess, who appeared in different forms for 9 days. According to the family, Radha had a vision of the Goddess in her dream some time ago. In which the Goddess said she would take birth in their house. Shortly after this, Radha went into labor. She was taken to Kuchela Health Center, where she gave birth to a girl. Family members claim that the newborn was completely healthy. Doctors also declared the baby normal, after which she was brought home. Radha says that the child gave her a dream before coming, and then labor pains started that same night. In the dream, she said, "Mother, I am taking birth through your womb. I am not a daughter, I am a mother." I had told my husband that I had a dream. The ultrasound had already indicated that it was neither a girl nor a boy. The doctor had said to get the operation done as soon as possible. But I did not get the operation done. Because my mother had stopped me, telling me not to do this, mother. Radha says that after birth, the doctor said the child was not alive. But I kept her for 8 days, on the ninth day everyone saw her, then there was a Devi Jagran. The child had told me in my dream that "Mother, I am going to take Samadhi. Build my place right here." She had come in the form of Kali. Family members make different claims Dainik Bhaskar spoke separately with family members, and they told different stories. Mother Radha first said that after coming from the hospital, the baby drank milk, then stopped drinking. After coming home, she showed a giant form and gave darshan in 9 forms. Charan Singh, brother of Kanchan (baby's father), says that the baby's features were like Mother Durga. She is a goddess. During the phone conversation, Charan Singh says that the baby girl remained alive for 9 days. During this time, she would drink small amounts of milk. Sometimes she would appear in the form of Kali, and sometimes in a giant form. Charan Singh and the girl's mother, Radha, say - We were sitting on a platform, when the mother went into a trance. Then, in my dream, the girl appeared and said that she is leaving. Her place should be made here. The family also claims that in the dream, the girl identified herself as the goddess of "Nadau Dham". The girl's father, Kanchan, says - My wife had a dream. In the hospital, she was told that she was neither a boy nor a girl. The girl was born in Kuchaila government hospital. Doctors declared her dead. After that, we brought her home. After coming home, the goddess changed her appearance. After that, a spiritual awakening began in the village. Now there is a huge crowd. Drums are being played. A place has been made, now they will build a temple.' However, later Radha also told that doctors had declared the baby dead at the time of birth. Radha said that the baby was born when there were 5-6 days left for the 8th month to complete. The doctors at the hospital said to take her home and perform the last rites. However, when I came home, the baby opened her eyes and appeared in the form of Mother Kali. What is Nadau Dham? According to locals, Nadau Dham is considered a divine place. People come from far and wide to visit here. This place is located about 2 kilometers away from the village. People's faith has increased here in the last three-four years. Now crowds regularly come for darshan. Kanchan, Radha, and her entire family always come here. Devotees who come here consider it a site connected to some avatar or divine power. There is also a prevalent belief about wishes being fulfilled. However, whatever stories and beliefs exist about Nadau Dham are based on local traditions. Kanchan and Radha got married 11 years ago Kanchan said that he works as a laborer. His wife is a housewife. Both are uneducated. They have a two-and-a-half-year-old son. This was their second daughter. Kanchan and Radha got married about 11 years ago. Kanchan has 5 brothers. He is fourth in order. All five brothers work as laborers. Kanchan lives separately with his parents, wife, and child. Neighbors said - Mother has power After this news spread, crowds started gathering in the village. A tent has been set up. The girl's body was adorned and given a burial on February 2. The place has been decorated. A photo of Kali has been placed on the tomb. Devotional songs, chanting, and religious ceremonies are being performed there. People are coming from far and wide for darshan. Preparations are being made to build a temple ahead. Village neighbor Ranjit Yadav claims that Mother Kali has power. Mother is true, mother's place is true. Mother took birth in the form of Kali. Devotees are coming from far and wide. Now there is a devotional atmosphere in the village. A temple will be built soon. So far, offerings worth 50 to 60 thousand have been made here. Doctor revealed the truth, said - the baby was stillborn We spoke to Dr. SS Bhadauria, superintendent of Kuchaila CHC. He said that the baby was stillborn. What do experts say? From a medical science perspective, this is an underdeveloped fetus. This happened due to a lack of timely ultrasound and other tests. However, due to superstition, people consider it a divine incarnation. Dr. Amit Shahi, psychiatrist at Gorakhpur District Hospital, says that such incidents have come to light before as well. However, due to superstition, people start considering them divine incarnations. Nothing like this happens. Dr. Sanjeev, MD Physician at Sanjeevani Hospital and Research Center in Gorakhpur, explains that sometimes at birth, some children have large eyes, a broad forehead, or a very small forehead. The facial features appear somewhat unusual. In such cases, symptoms of congenital deformity may be visible in the newborn. In medical terms, this is called Congenital Deformity. It's possible that this child had some internal medical condition. However, without a medical examination, it's not possible to say what the problem is.

stories.title: Love story of constable who ran away with history-sheeter:First met at aunt’s house in Meerut; woman insists she will marry Ankit
stories.summary: While investigating the kidnapping case of Constable Sandhya Bhardwaj from Meerut, police uncovered her love story. On her wedding day, she had willingly gone with history-sheeter Ankit Chauhan. Both wanted to have a court marriage, but police surveillance increased. That's why, within just 8 hours of the kidnapping, the female constable herself reached the Mawana police station. Two major developments occurred in this case in the last 48 hours. First- On February 9, the female constable gave her statement in court. Second- On February 10, the history-sheeter surrendered in court and was sent to jail. The constable said in court- I went with Ankit of my own will. We were going to have a court marriage. Before that my mother came there. That's why we couldn't do the court marriage. Actually, Sandhya's marriage was fixed with Atul Sharma, a constable posted at Bannadevi police station in Aligarh. The wedding was to take place on February 8, but Sandhya ran away that morning. Because of this, her father's health deteriorated, and he had to be admitted to the hospital. The female constable broke off her marriage in one stroke and rebelled against her family. However, this didn't happen suddenly. It began 12 years ago when the female constable was studying in 9th grade while living with her aunt 6km away from her village. Read the love story where a female constable rebelled against the entire system... First know what happened on the wedding day At 2 AM, Ankit came on bike and took Sandhya with him On February 7, Constable Sandhya's house in Akbarpur Sadat village of the Bahsuma area was decorated. Inside the house, women were singing congratulatory songs on the drum. Family members were making wedding preparations. Brother Prince said - The entire wedding arrangement was made at Pradhan Farm House, located near DPM School. After running around all day, we were tired. All the chaos happened at 2 AM, when a bike stopped outside the house. It was none other than history-sheeter Ankit Chauhan who had reached our house. He called Sandhya. After a while, Sandhya's family members also came out of the house. The commotion began. Ankit shouted - When I had said that Sandhya would marry me, why are you arranging her marriage somewhere else? After this, Sandhya sat with him on the bike. Before the family members could stop her, both of them left from there. After this incident, father Subhash Sharma filed an FIR against Ankit Chauhan for kidnapping his daughter at the police station. Police increased security at the Meerut border. The case was related to a female constable who was kidnapped before her wedding. They were planning court marriage, but events changed rapidly On the other hand, Sandhya's mother was continuously calling and trying to convince her daughter. She was trying to follow Sandhya through a family member. Sandhya and Ankit had already prepared for their court marriage. Sandhya told her mother on the phone not to worry. She said she is getting married, but now the groom would be of her choice, not her mother's. Two stories emerged about how Sandhya was found Sandhya was angry with her family, so she did not return to her father's house, but went to her maternal grandparents' home. Upon reaching there, Sandhya told the whole story to the family. After this, Sandhya's statements were recorded at the Mawana police station. Meanwhile, in the report filed by the police, Sandhya's father accused Ankit Chauhan. He claimed that Ankit had kidnapped Sandhya. The police then made changes to the report. Now read Sandhya-Ankit's love story Met at aunt's house, meetings began after friendship Sandhya also told her love story to the Mawana police station SHO Poonam Jadaun. According to Sandhya, this is from 2015-16. Her family lived in the Akbarpur Sadat village of Bahsuma. Sandhya completed her schooling from Manful Kanya Inter College, Bahsuma. She did her college studies at ASPG College, Mawana. Sandhya completed her B.COM from here. When Sandhya was studying in 9th grade, she went to her aunt's village, Dhakol, 6km away from her village. Ankit Chauhan also lived in the same village. At that time, he was studying in the 10th grade. After this, Ankit left his studies. However, he used to visit Sandhya's aunt's house. This was the time when Sandhya and Ankit met. First at home, then they started meeting outside too, but it was just friendship. Neither of them realized that they were slowly getting bound in the delicate thread of love. Even at Aunt's house, they only knew that Ankit and Sandhya were friends. After completing her studies in 2021, Sandhya was selected in UP Police. She was posted at the Cyber Crime station. Meanwhile, Ankit Chauhan was getting more established in the world of crime. One by one, 11 cases were registered against him. He became a history-sheeter in police records. A lot changed, but Sandhya and Ankit's love did not diminish. During this time, Sandhya's marriage was arranged with Atul Sharma, a constable posted at Bannadevi police station in Aligarh. Then Sandhya spoke to her family about Ankit Chauhan. Family members said that you want to leave a policeman to build a home with a history-sheeter. We won't let this happen. After this, Sandhya planned to run away from home with Ankit. CO Mawana Pankaj Lawania said - In May 2025, Ankit Chauhan had robbed a liquor shop. The shop owner was murdered in this incident. Ankit was shot in the leg during a police encounter. Police had sent him to jail. Ankit had just been released from jail a few days ago. Ankit has 9 cases registered at Mawana police station and 2 cases at Kila Parikshitgarh police station. A history sheet was opened against Ankit for murdering the shop owner. He is connected to Meerut's Golu gang. Now read the full statement of Sandhya's father First wanted to become a teacher, then got selected in UP Police Father Subhash Sharma says - Sandhya is the eldest among four siblings. The second brother, Prince, is doing BSc. After him, there's Harshit and a younger sister, too. All are studying. Sandhya first wanted to become a teacher. She didn't pursue B.Ed, so she decided to join the police department. She had cleared the 2020 recruitment exam too, but fell behind in the running test. After that, she took the railway exam and cleared that too. Their height became an issue. Then she cracked the Delhi Police exam as well, but couldn't get selected due to height requirements. After passing the 2021 UP Police exam, she became a constable. Father's claim - Kidnapped through threats Subhash Sharma says - If Sandhya wanted to do as she pleased, she would have left from duty itself. She had done all her wedding shopping. She was very happy about her wedding. No signs of stress were visible on her face. Surely Ankit must have threatened her or taken her away at gunpoint. The father also said that when the groom's side learned about the daughter's disappearance, they gathered all the information over the phone. They had assured all possible help, but there was no communication with them after that. He said that the engagement took place on February 5, in which they have already sent most of the dowry items to the daughter's in-laws. This includes one lakh rupees in cash.

stories.title: Yogi govt may hike pensions, Shiksha Mitra honorarium:UP budget 2026 to prioritise women, youth, employment and key voter groups across state
stories.summary: Uttar Pradesh Finance Minister Suresh Khanna will present the fifth budget of Yogi Adityanath government 2.0 in the state Assembly on Wednesday. With Assembly elections due next year, this budget is being widely seen as the government’s election budget. The Model Code of Conduct is expected to come into force by the first week of January 2027, making this the last full budget before elections. The government is expected to use the budget to consolidate its voter base, with special focus on women, youth, farmers, workers and government employees. The total budget size is likely to exceed Rs 9.20 lakh crore. In this, the government will try to appease women, youth, farmers, laborers, and employees to consolidate its vote bank. The size of the budget could be more than 9 lakh 20 thousand crore. Read a special report on UP Budget… Budget cleared, cabinet nod awaited Finance Minister Suresh Khanna and Additional Chief Secretary (Finance) Deepak Kumar have finalized the budget draft, which has already received approval from Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath. A formal cabinet approval will be taken in a meeting chaired by the Chief Minister on Wednesday morning. Following this, the Finance Minister will present the budget in the Assembly at 11 am, while Deputy CM Keshav Prasad Maurya will table it in the Legislative Council. Budget size likely to cross ₹9 lakh crore In the financial year 2025–26, the UP government had presented a budget of over ₹8.7 lakh crore, followed by two supplementary budgets. Experts point out that the state government increases the budget size by nearly 20 percent every year, and with elections approaching, there is little chance of fiscal restraint. The upcoming budget is expected to cross ₹9.20 lakh crore. What to expect in the budget Outsourcing recruitment through service corporation The state government has formed an Outsourcing Employees Service Corporation. It is expected that the budget may include provisions for recruitment through this body. Before elections, the government is reportedly planning to recruit over 50,000 outsourced employees, along with a possible increase in their honorarium. Pension amount may be increased The government may announce a hike in monthly pensions for: The pension amount could be raised from ₹1,000 to ₹1,500 per month. Honorarium hike for Shiksha Mitras and instructors The budget may also bring relief to: Their monthly honorarium is expected to be increased by ₹2,000 each. Eighth pay commission announcement likely The government may announce the implementation of the 8th Pay Commission in Uttar Pradesh from April 1, 2026. This move would directly benefit: Women and Youth to remain in focus To strengthen the women voter base, the government may announce: For youth, the budget may include: Metro expansion and Infrastructure push The budget is expected to include provisions for: According to finance department officials, infrastructure development will remain a major focus area. MLAs may receive ₹10 crore or more for road construction projects in their respective constituencies. Focus on BJP’s 2022 manifesto promises Before the 2022 Assembly elections, the BJP had released a manifesto with 131 promises. Most major commitments have either been fulfilled or are under implementation. Experts believe that due to the election year, the government may announce completion of the remaining 8–9 pending promises in this budget. Nationwide attention on UP budget The Uttar Pradesh budget is expected to draw attention not only within the state but also from political analysts and economic experts across the country. Citizens will closely watch what promises the government fulfills ahead of elections and which new welfare schemes are announced. Supplementary budget also an option Political analysts note that the BJP often prefers strategic timing. It is possible that major announcements may be deferred, with big-ticket decisions announced later through a supplementary budget during the monsoon or winter Assembly session, depending on the political climate.
