stories.title: If you are a Yogi then why on CM's chair?:Avimukteshwaranand hits back CM, says, 'Shankaracharya doesn't need govt certificate'
stories.summary: Shankaracharya Swami Avimukteshwaranand, responding to CM Yogi Adityanath’s remarks in Varanasi, said the identity of a Shankaracharya in Sanatan Dharma cannot be decided by any government or political certificate. He criticised the issuance of such recognition to Swami Vasudevanand, noting that courts have restrained him from being called Shankaracharya. He also accused both SP and the current government of disrespecting religious leaders, warning against political arrogance. Questioning Yogi’s dual role, he cited Nath tradition teachings that a yogi should remain detached from state power. His response came after the Chief Minister said in the Assembly that not everyone can claim the title of Shankaracharya and that no one is above the law. Read in the QA what Shankaracharya said- Question: CM said that no one can call themselves Shankaracharya. What would you say? Answer: His words seem correct, but the question is whether a person who is the Chief Minister won't write Chief Minister before their name? They surely will. Similarly, why can't someone who is Shankaracharya write Shankaracharya before their name? It's not like a Chief Minister or government can appoint a Shankaracharya by giving a certificate. There is no such tradition in Sanatan Dharma. The tradition of Shankaracharya is determined by religious-spiritual means, not by political approval. Question: What is the definition of Shankaracharya in Sanatan? Answer: A Shankaracharya is one who works for Sanatan. The first attribute of Sanatan is 'Truth'. One who speaks the truth, protects cow-mother and dharma is worthy of being called Shankaracharya. This definition is not new, it has been continuing for centuries. Question: Why are you questioning the CM being a "Yogi"? Answer: We haven't raised any personal questions, but rather traditional questions. We are asking how can a person who calls himself a yogi of the Gorakhnath tradition accept political power? This is a question of religious and sectarian dignity. Many saints of the Nath sect have contacted us saying that such conduct is not acceptable according to tradition. A person who knows the depth of dharma understands this. We are asking - how did they become Mahant? Everyone knows that the previous Mahant was their relative. Was this selection made through tradition or family influence? The MLAs wanted to choose someone else as leader-chief minister, but his name was proposed from above. In such a case, what are his qualifications? Family relations and support of a particular organization? The Chief Minister said in the house that we know how to follow the law and also know how to make others follow it. This language does not suit someone sitting in a constitutional position. The language of law is about punishment and procedure, not about arrogance and threats. Question: What is your objection regarding the police action? Answer: We are asking why the Chief Minister did not say a word about the police using force against children, the elderly and women? There must be accountability. The Chief Minister said people didn't know before, but we publicised it. This is arrogance. Kumbh Mela and Magh Mela have been the world's largest religious events for centuries. To say that nobody knew about it before is an insult to history. Question: In 2015, you faced a lathi charge during SP government. What would you say? Answer: We protested then, too. Power brings arrogance; it was there then, it's there now. Arrogance destroys power. Before becoming Chief Minister, he (Yogi) had several criminal cases against him. After coming to power, they were withdrawn. Can any person withdraw cases against themselves? If everyone is equal, why were only his cases withdrawn? Is this justified? Question: What is your demand regarding the entire controversy? Answer: We want Governor Anandiben Patel to take cognisance. Ask on what basis force was used against innocent people. CM should also clarify how he justifies the conflict between the Yogi tradition and state power. Know what Yogi said in the assembly one day before on Avimukteshwaranand controversy Yogi said - Not everyone can be Shankaracharya CM Yogi Adityanath spoke in the assembly on Friday regarding the Shankaracharya Avimukteshwaranand controversy. Yogi said - Not everyone can write Shankaracharya. No one is above the law. Not even me. I believe every person in India should follow the law. If SP people want to worship him, they can worship. The CM said - An issue was deliberately created in the Magh Mela, which wasn't there. Can every person roam around the entire state, becoming Chief Minister? Can someone roam around putting up a Minister's board? Can someone roam around the state becoming SP president? No... There is a system, there is an order. Akhilesh's counter-attack - Getting your ears pierced doesn't make you a Yogi SP chief Akhilesh Yadav hit back at CM Yogi. He said - Can he be a Yogi? Who gave him the certificate of being a Yogi? Many things are clear in the Hindu tradition. Where there are saffron robes, we look at them with respect. But Yogiji, who is our Chief Minister, has no respect. Wearing clothes and getting ears pierced doesn't make you a Yogi. If you have a desire within you, you cannot be a Yogi. Our revered Shankaracharya, whom everyone respects, was not allowed to take a bath. Since the earth exists, no one has stopped saints from taking a bath in the Ganges. He is the first one who has stopped them from bathing. Who will save him when he incurs sin? 'The same law applies to me as it does to any common person' Yogi said - This is the same system in India's Sanatan Dharma. In Sanatan Dharma, the position of Shankaracharya is considered supreme and sacred. Look at the system of the House; there is also tradition here. The House operates according to rules. On Mauni Amavasya in the Magh Mela, 4.5 crore people came. A system was created for everyone. The law is equal for all. The same law applies to me as it does to any common person. No person can be above the law. It is my belief that every person in India should follow the law. Asked SP - If he was Shankaracharya, then why did you order lathi charge on him CM said - There is a sacred tradition of Shankaracharya in the country. Jagadguru Shankaracharya established four seats in four corners of the country. Jyotish Peeth is established in the north, Sringeri in the south, Puri in the east and Dwarka in the west. The four seats have four Vedas. Rigveda, Yajurveda, Samaveda and Atharvaveda. They all have their own mantras. Adi Jagat Guru Shankaracharya made it mandatory that whoever is eligible for whichever seat would be recognised according to tradition. Yogi said - Not everyone can write Shankaracharya. Not everyone can go around as an Acharya and spoil the atmosphere. Everyone must follow the protocols. If he were Shankaracharya, then why did you (SP) people order a lathi charge in Varanasi? Why did you file an FIR? What kind of morality are you talking about? Blocked the road leading to Magh Mela Yogi said - There was a crowd of 4.5 crore at the Magh Mela that day (Mauni Amavasya). The road where people were going was blocked. This cannot be the work of any responsible person. No responsible person can behave like this. If SP people want to worship him, let them worship. But we are dignified people, we believe in rule of law, we follow rule of law, and we know how to enforce it too. We want to implement both things together. Stop misleading people in its name. Yogi called him Kalnemi without naming Avimukteshwaranand Amid the Shankaracharya controversy, CM Yogi was in Sonipat, Haryana, on January 22. Without naming Avimukteshwaranand, he had said - No one has the right to disrupt tradition. There are many Kalnemis who are conspiring to weaken Sanatan Dharma under the guise of religion. We need to be cautious of such people. For a sanyasi, nothing is above dharma and nation. The Kalnemi that Yogi mentioned was Ravana's maternal uncle and Mareech's son in the Ramayana. Ravana had sent him to stop Hanuman when Lakshmana was unconscious. Later, Hanuman killed Kalnemi. Yogi's statement was linked to Shankaracharya Avimukteshwaranand. Shankaracharya called Yogi a fake Hindu On this, Shankaracharya Avimukteshwaranand said - The robe is of a saint, but cow slaughter is happening. Now you tell me who Kalnemi is? Kalnemi was a demon who appeared disguised as a saint. What did the demon do? Kill Brahmins, humans, and cows while wearing a saint's robe. Look here, the robe is of a saint, but cow slaughter is happening. Now you tell me who Kalnemi is? In Muslims, the religious leader is the Caliph (head of state). This Caliphate tradition is being brought into Hinduism. The state government had asked me to provide proof of being Shankaracharya within 24 hours. I submitted this within the deadline. After this, I gave the government 40 days to prove they are real Hindus. But even after 10 days have passed, no proof has come from the government. Yogi is a fake Hindu. Now know what happened during the bath on Mauni Amavasya... On January 18, during Mauni Amavasya at the Magh Mela, Shankaracharya Avimukteshwaranand was going for a bath in a palanquin. The police stopped Shankaracharya Swami Avimukteshwaranand's palanquin. Police asked him to walk to Sangam. Shankaracharya's disciples did not agree and started moving forward with the palanquin. This led to pushing and shoving between the disciples and the police. Police took several disciples into custody. Police also beat up a sadhu at the police post. This angered Shankaracharya, and he insisted on getting his disciples released. Officials tried to reason with him, folded their hands, but he did not agree. After this, the police took several more supporters of Shankaracharya into custody. Shankaracharya's palanquin was dragged 1 km away from the Sangam. During this, the canopy of the palanquin also broke. Shankaracharya could not even take a bath. Shankaracharya remained on protest outside his camp until January 28. Then returned to Varanasi. Shankaracharya had said- High-ranking officers were beating our saints. Initially we were returning, but now we will take a bath and won't go anywhere. They cannot stop us. They must have orders from above to harass us. This is happening at the government's behest because they are angry with us. When there was a stampede in Mahakumbh, I had held them responsible. Now they must be telling officers to take revenge." Pictures of clash between Shankaracharya's disciples and police-

stories.title: Shoaib killing- 4 bullets in body, 5 in car:Police pick up three from Lucknow, wife lodges FIR in Barabanki
stories.summary: In Barabanki, Shoaib Kidwai alias Bobby, a close associate of Mukhtar Ansari and a known history-sheeter, was shot dead on Friday afternoon. He was 50 years old. The attack took place around 1:30 PM while he was travelling by car from Lucknow to Barabanki. The post-mortem examination was conducted later in the evening. According to police sources, Shoaib sustained four bullet injuries — one to the jaw, one to the right hand, one to the chest and one to the leg. The vehicle he was travelling in bore five bullet marks: one on the bonnet, three on the windows and one on the driver’s side door. The motive behind the murder remains unclear. Police have constituted seven teams to investigate the case. Apart from Barabanki police, teams from Lucknow are also assisting in gathering inputs related to the killing. Shoaib is scheduled to be buried on Saturday, and in view of possible tension, heavy police deployment has been made in the area. According to officials, Shoaib had just entered Barabanki from Lucknow. About 100 metres after taking a turn from the highway, two assailants on a motorcycle intercepted his car. Before he could react, they opened indiscriminate fire using pistols. Police sources say more than 15 rounds were fired. After carrying out the attack, the accused fled towards Ayodhya. On receiving information, police rushed to the spot and took Shoaib to a nearby hospital, where doctors declared him dead. The incident occurred near the Aseni turn on the Lucknow–Ayodhya highway in the Kotwali area. The car was found riddled with bullet marks at multiple points. See pictures related to the incident- Police have sealed the crime scene. The forensic team has collected evidence from the spot. IG Praveen Kumar, DM and SP reached the spot after receiving information about the murder. Bobby had 12 cases registered against him related to murder, extortion and gang wars. According to sources, there was an internal power struggle and mutual rivalry within the gang after Mukhtar's death. Shoaib was also a lawyer. He had been practicing law in court for about 15 years. In protest against the murder, lawyers first created a ruckus at the district hospital. After causing commotion at the district hospital for quite some time, the lawyers blocked the road in front of the bus stand. Seeing the situation escalate, the SP called a delegation of lawyers to the office to explain. The lawyers submitted a petition demanding the arrest of Bobby's attackers within 48 hours. Shoaib's one brother lives in England Shoaib has a house in Civil Lines in Barabanki. He was the second among three brothers. His family includes wife Shazia Khan and 15-year-old son Armaan Kidwai. Armaan is a 9th class student in a Lucknow school. His in-laws are in Malihabad, Lucknow and he also has a house in Gomti Nagar. Elder brother Javed is a lawyer in Barabanki. Younger brother Sohail Kidwai lives in England. He has one sister who is married. Shoaib was both a shooter and practiced law. He was also active in politics. He had contested as an independent candidate for the Block Pramukh position of Banki block in Barabanki. But he lost. He played an important role in land grabbing, interfering in contracts and eliminating opponents for the Mukhtar gang. Surveillance began right after leaving Lucknow According to police sources, Shoaib was coming to Barabanki from Lucknow. As soon as he left Lucknow, he was being tracked. The attackers couldn't strike on the highway due to the car's high speed. As soon as Bobby moved the car to the service lane and slowed down, the attackers found their opportunity and executed the attack. Eyewitness said - One shot from the front, the other came close and fired According to an eyewitness, as soon as Shoaib turned onto the service lane from Ayodhya highway to go to Barabanki in his Baleno car, two attackers on bikes who were following him came from the side and moved to the front. Before Shoaib could understand anything, one of them started firing bullets rapidly. The second attacker reached near the driver's side door, he went close and fired multiple shots. Within two minutes, after completing the murder, the attackers fled at full speed on their bike towards Ayodhya. During the incident, three bullets hit the front windshield of the car, one bullet hit the bonnet and one bullet mark is also visible on the driver's side door. Shoaib was also accused of arranging bulletproof ambulance for Mukhtar Bobby was a member of Mukhtar's gang IS 191. Mukhtar Ansari died of heart attack in Banda jail on March 28, 2024. Before this, he was imprisoned in Punjab's Ropar jail. Police had presented Mukhtar in Mohali court of Punjab by bringing him in a Barabanki number (UP 41 AT 7171) ambulance. After this, the ambulance was found abandoned near a dhaba on the roadside on Chandigarh-Nangal highway, 15 km away from Ropar jail in Rupnagar district. The ambulance had luxury amenities. It was bulletproof. The Barabanki Transport Department and Health Department investigated the documents. It was found that the letter from Shyam Sanjeevani Hospital located in Mau and Dr. Alka Rai's voter card were attached in the transport department. However, the registration document and house address were found to be fake. In this case, Barabanki's ARTO filed a case against Dr. Alka Rai at the City Kotwali under IPC sections 419, 420, 467, 468, and 471. The allegation then was that Shoaib helped Mukhtar Ansari register an ambulance in Barabanki using forged documents. Shoaib made headlines in jail superintendent murder case Shoaib Bobby's name came up in the high-profile murder case of jail superintendent Ramakant Tiwari. Ramakant Tiwari was murdered on February 4, 1999. He was returning at 7 PM after attending a meeting at the then Lucknow DM Sadakant's residence. As he reached near Raj Bhavan, criminals opened rapid fire on him. He died on the spot. In this murder case, more than a dozen people were named including bahubali MLA Mukhtar Ansari, rebel SP MLA Abhay Singh, Chandan Negi, Bauwa Tiwari. Chandan Negi was murdered in Lucknow on February 16, 2002. After this, Bauwa Tiwari was killed in a police encounter near Kukrail on March 13, 2002. The remaining accused were acquitted by the court Mukhtar's cousin withdraws bail petition amid murder case After Shoaib Kidwai's murder, mafia Mukhtar Ansari's cousin Gaus Mohiuddin alias Tannu withdrew his bail application from Ghazipur's MP-MLA court on Thursday. Everyone was surprised by his request during the court hearing. It is believed that he did this due to concerns about his safety. Gaus Mohiuddin alias Tannu, a resident of Muhammadabad, had a reward of 25 thousand rupees on him in a murder case. He had been absconding for the past 2 years. Police had recently arrested him and sent him to jail. Tannu's name is linked to accusations of being wanted in the 2001 notorious Usri gang war witness and Manoj Rai kidnapping-murder case. Buxar resident Shailendra Rai had filed a case regarding the kidnapping and murder of his son Manoj Rai. During the hearing in Judge Shakti Singh's court on Friday, the court framed charges against Gaus Mohiuddin. The next hearing of the case will be on February 26. He had filed a bail application in this case.

stories.title: Yogi to inaugurate Kalyan Mandapam in Gorakhpur:Built with capacity for 300 people; to also perform Jalabhishek at Shiva temple
stories.summary: Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath will inaugurate a newly constructed Kalyan Mandapam in Gorakhpur today during his three-day visit to the city. The facility has been built at a cost of Rs 2.47 crore and can accommodate up to 300 people. The project has been executed by the Gorakhpur Development Authority (GDA), with funds contributed from the Chief Minister’s MLA fund. Multiple development projects on agenda Before the inauguration, the Chief Minister will visit Jungle Kaudia, where he will inaugurate the newly constructed main gate at the block premises, the reconstructed BDO office building, and other strengthening, beautification, and boundary wall works. The Jungle Kaudia building was originally constructed in 1962. He will also offer prayers at the Jharkhandi Shiva Temple. Between February 2025 and February 2026, four Kalyan Mandapams have already been inaugurated in Khorabar, Surajkund, Manbela, and Rapti Nagar Extension areas of the city. According to the GDA, construction is ongoing in Jungle Benimadhav, Basharatpur, Nakaha No. 2, Mahadev Jharkhandi Tukda No. 2, and Semra. Ahead of the inauguration ceremony, GDA Vice-Chairman Anand Vardhan inspected the site to review preparations. CM to perform Jalabhishek at 3 Shiva Temples On the auspicious occasion of Maha Shivratri, CM Yogi, who is also the Gorakshpeethadhishwar, will offer prayers at the Gorakhnath Temple. He will perform Jalabhishek at three major Shiva temples in Gorakhpur — Mansarovar Temple, Mukteshwarnath Temple at Rajghat, and Piteshwarnath Shiva Temple in Bharohiya — praying for public welfare. On the eve of Maha Shivratri, he will also visit the historically significant Mahadev Jharkhandi temple for darshan and worship. As per Nath tradition, Maha Shivratri holds special importance, and even after becoming Chief Minister, Yogi Adityanath continues to celebrate the festival in Gorakhpur, centered around the Gorakshpeeth. Tal Ring Road Project nears completion The Chief Minister will also conduct a site inspection of the under-construction 4.8-kilometre Tal Ring Road project from Mohaddipur to Sahara Estate. Being developed by the Gorakhpur Development Authority under the Rapid Economic Development Scheme, the two-lane road is expected to improve traffic flow and enhance the beauty of the Tal area. The project is estimated to cost around Rs 28 crore and is likely to be completed by May 2026. The 12-metre-wide road will include a 7-metre-wide main carriageway and footpaths on both sides. The section along the Tal is being built using piling, concrete, and steel beams, with steel railings for safety and aesthetics. A proposal has also been sent to the government for approval of Tal front development and construction of a boat jetty. Officials expect the project to significantly improve the city’s traffic management system once completed.

stories.title: Bride threatens groom on wedding night in Kanpur:Woman claims her love for another man; husband seeks police help after months of fear
stories.summary: On the wedding night in Kanpur, the bride threatened her husband. She said - Stay away from me. Don't touch me. I belong to someone else. If you touch me, you will lose your life. If you want what's good for you, send me to my boyfriend. For 2 months, the groom tried to convince the bride. But she didn't agree. One day, the bride put a noose around her neck. The young man somehow saved her. After this, the bride threatened him again. Two and a half months after the wedding, the frightened young man reached the police station. He pleaded with the police to save his life. The case is from the Ghatampur police station. A girl from a village in the Maharajpur police station area got married on November 23 to a boy from a village in the Sadh police station area. After the wedding, the bride reached her in-laws' house. The groom said that on the wedding night, he went to the bride. As soon as he tried to lift her veil, she stepped back. The bride told him to stay away from her. She said there is someone else in her life. This body and mind belong to him only. Don't even try to touch me. She said that she loves another boy. She wants to spend her life with him only. If you want to stay happy and want to live, then leave me. Drop me off at my boyfriend's house. I tried to convince her all night. But she didn't agree. She remained stubborn. I thought she would agree in a day or two. Every night, I tried to convince her. But she didn't agree. Young man said - I am in depression due to her threats The boy said - I have been trying to make her understand for two and a half months. But instead of understanding, she kept threatening me. I went into depression. I didn't tell anything to my family anything. On February 11, I was trying to make her understand, but she got angry. She threatened - If she can't be his (boyfriend's), she can't be anyone's. Then she went into the room. She locked the door from inside. She tried to take her life by hanging. When I saw this, I broke down the room door and saved her life. After this, my family learned the truth. Family members also tried to explain to her, but she didn't listen. On February 12, I reached the police station and filed a complaint. When she used to threaten me, I had recorded her threats on the phone. I have also given that recording to the police. Sadh Police Station in-charge Inspector Avanish Kumar Singh said that both families were called to the police station. No written complaint has been given by any party. Both families have been asked to resolve the matter through dialogue.

stories.title: What does SP want to achieve with Nasimuddin's entry?:Alliance fear or perception war between Owaisi and Mayawati
stories.summary: SP-Congress fought together in the 2024 Lok Sabha election in UP. Both are preparing to contest the 2027 assembly under the grand alliance banner. But in the discussions is Nasimuddin Siddiqui, who left Congress and is about to join SP. Why is SP going to include a major Congress leader in the party? Does SP fear losing the Muslim vote bank in 2027, or are they trying to find a counter to the potential Owaisi-Mayawati alliance? SP chief Akhilesh Yadav will induct Nasimuddin Siddiqui into the party on 15 February, along with several former MLAs, MPs, and workers from across districts. Ahead of the 2027 elections, SP aims to strengthen its Muslim support, which makes up about 19% of Uttar Pradesh’s voters and largely backs the party. While Azam Khan remains SP’s most prominent Muslim face, his legal troubles prevent him and his family from contesting elections. SP is expanding its base through the PDA (Backward, Dalit, Minority) formula, where Muslims play a decisive role. Bringing in Siddiqui is seen as a strategic move to reinforce Muslim confidence and counter the potential influence of Asaduddin Owaisi’s AIMIM, which is exploring alliances and planning to contest Muslim-majority seats. Through this induction, SP seeks to project unity and position itself as the strongest challenger to the BJP in the 2027 Assembly elections. If Owaisi contests it's a loss, if he doesn't then SP benefits In the 2024 Lok Sabha elections, SP and Congress contested together under the grand alliance. SP received massive support from Muslim votes, helping the party achieve its biggest success to date. Both parties are preparing to contest under the same banner in the 2027 assembly elections. However, there's a looming threat to the Muslim vote bank. Asaduddin Owaisi's AIMIM won more than 125 seats in the recent Maharashtra local body elections, including capturing SP's traditional strongholds in Muslim-majority areas like Govandi-Mankhurd in Mumbai. SP was reduced to just 2 seats. These results are a matter of concern for SP. In Maharashtra, AIMIM has breached SP's vote bank, where leaders like Abu Asim Azmi had been strong for a long time. Owaisi had openly targeted Akhilesh Yadav and said that when Muslim leadership emerges, Akhilesh's 'shop will close down'. AIMIM claims that SP and Congress consider Muslims only as a vote bank, don't give them representation. In UP's 2022 assembly elections, AIMIM contested on 100 seats but didn't win any. However, it damaged SP in several places. For example, SP lost the Kursi seat in Barabanki by 217 votes. While AIMIM got 8,541 votes. BJP benefited from this. When AIMIM did not field candidates in UP for the 2024 Lok Sabha, Muslim voters remained united and SP benefited. After victories in Bihar-Maharashtra, AIMIM has geared up for the 2027 UP Assembly elections. Its focus is on the western regions of UP where the Muslim population is higher. According to the 2022 CSDS-Lokniti survey, SP received 79% of Muslim votes while BJP got 8%. SP wants to gather all Muslim votes. In 2017, SP suffered losses due to division of Muslim votes BJP had returned to power in the state by winning the 2017 assembly elections. The division of Muslim votes was cited as a major reason then. At that time, Muslims were divided between BSP-SP. As a result, the BJP had won 62 out of 82 such Muslim-majority seats where Muslim voters constitute one-third of the population. Numbers show that the BJP benefited from the division of Muslim votes in about two dozen seats. These included Muzaffarnagar, Shamli, Saharanpur, Bareilly, Bijnor, Sardhana of Meerut, Khalilabad of Gorakhpur, Tanda of Ambedkar Nagar, Shravasti and Gainsari of Shravasti district, and Moradabad seat. BJP also won in Deoband, which has a Muslim population of 1.25 lakh. The Muslim community was split between SP's Mavia Ali and BSP's Majid Ali. From Faizabad's Rudauli seat, BJP's Ramchandra Yadav defeated SP's Abbas Ali Zaidi by 30 thousand votes. Similarly, other seats included Thana Bhawan seat of Shamli, Lucknow (East), Lucknow (Central), Aligarh, Siwalkhash, Nanpara, Shahabad, Bahedi, Firozabad, Chandpur, and Kundarki. In 2022, SP received strong support from Muslims Compared to 2017, SP received strong Muslim support in the 2022 assembly elections. According to the Lokniti-CSDS survey, SP received 77-79 percent of Muslim votes in this election. This was the reason that SP's vote bank reached 32 percent and its seat count increased to 111. While BSP had given the most tickets to Muslims. But it received only 6-7 percent of Muslim votes, and its vote bank fell from 22 to below 13 percent. Only one of its candidates, Umashankar Singh from Rasda, could win. In the 2024 Lok Sabha elections, SP received 90-92 percent Muslim support. Then SP, along with its alliance partner Congress won 43 seats in UP. This includes 6 Congress MPs. BSP is also trying to woo Muslims BSP has also been active for the last six months. Mayawati herself attended the Muslim Brotherhood meeting and openly offered that if the Muslim community supports her, she will defeat the BJP. She also argued that even with full Muslim support, SP is unable to defeat the BJP. Nasimuddin Siddiqui was in BSP before Congress. His political journey also started with BSP. He was most active in Western UP. In such a situation, the SP chief wants to counter BSP's influence through Siddiqui. Senior journalist Rajendra Kumar says - Nasimuddin was never a leader with mass support. Even in BSP, he could win an election only once. After that, he lost every election. It's a different matter that he remained influential in BSP and served as minister of several departments. His identity in BSP remained primarily as a fund manager. Nasimuddin Siddiqui's joining won't benefit SP much, but he himself could gain a significant advantage from it. He may be able to establish his son in politics. How much risk of dissatisfaction among old BSP members and Congress in SP Before Nasimuddin, many leaders, MLAs, and MPs in SP were once in BSP. However, they never had good relations with Nasimuddin while in BSP. Now that Nasimuddin Siddiqui is joining SP, it is inevitable for these leaders to feel uncomfortable. Sources connected to SP say that old BSP members, including Babu Singh Kushwaha, RK Chaudhary, Indrajit Saroj, Ram Achal Rajbhar, and Lalji Verma, are unhappy with the decision of Nasimuddin joining the party. However, due to it being the SP chief's decision, they are unable to openly oppose it. Second, like BSP, SP's other Muslim leaders are also not going to give importance to Nasimuddin. Everyone has their own support base in their respective areas. Many SP leaders are saying privately that they don't need a fund manager. But officially, everyone is avoiding saying anything. Regarding Congress's displeasure over Nasimuddin joining SP, Congress spokesperson Surendra Singh says that he had left the party long ago. Where he is going now and what he is doing should be his concern. Congress is focused on strengthening its organization. Why not aggressive against Congress, reason now revealed Nasimuddin was not aggressive against Congress. Even pictures of Congress leaders Rahul, Priyanka, and Sonia Gandhi are hung at his residence. Besides this, Kanshi Ram's picture is also hung at his residence. Nasimuddin Siddiqui had told Dainik Bhaskar that his intention was not to weaken Congress. Now, amid news of joining SP, it has become clear why he remained soft on Congress. SP and Congress have an alliance in UP. This alliance will continue in the 2027 assembly elections, as indicated by the national leaders of both parties. In such a situation, Nasimuddin was already cautious and was not making any comments about Congress that could become an issue for Congress. Nasimuddin Siddiqui's career was started as a railway contractor Nasimuddin Siddiqui's name has been prominent in Uttar Pradesh politics for a long time. Nasimuddin Siddiqui was born on June 4, 1959. There was no political background in the family. After leaving his army job due to his mother's illness, he became active in railway contracting. Around 1990, Nasimuddin came in contact with BSP founder Kanshi Ram. It started with the Palika (Municipal) elections. He joined BSP in 1984. In 1991, he was elected MLA for the first time from the Banda assembly seat. He was BSP's first Muslim MLA. Called Mini CM in BSP government Nasimuddin Siddiqui, once a powerful leader in the BSP and known as the “Mini CM” during the 2007–2012 Mayawati government, held 18 ministries and had major influence in party affairs. He later served as Leader of Opposition from 2012 to 2017 but was expelled by Mayawati in 2017. After forming his own party, he joined Congress in 2018 as a prominent Muslim face, but resigned on 24 January. Now, ahead of the assembly elections, he is set to join the Samajwadi Party on 15 February in the presence of Akhilesh Yadav.

stories.title: Woman elopes with son-in-law, leaves him after 10 months:Accuses partner of abuse; regrets leaving children behind in Agra
stories.summary: Sapna Devi, who had eloped with son-in-law Rahul before daughter’s wedding, has returned in Aligarh after 10 months. She says she regrets leaving her children and now wants to live independently. Sapna has accused Rahul of harassment, while he claims she wanted to live with her brother-in-law Devendra. Devendra denies the allegations, calling Rahul a liar and questioning his intentions, noting that he ran away with his would-be mother-in-law instead of marrying her daughter. After returning from Bihar, Sapna approached multiple police stations. Following a local settlement, she stayed briefly at Devendra’s home but left on 13 February, and her current whereabouts are unknown. Devendra said - Wherever the police is calling, I am going and telling them that the talk of an affair between Sapna Devi and me is wrong. He says - A few days ago, I had an accident. I am a driver in Trans India, managing the family with great difficulty. My name has been forcefully dragged into this. Rahul should understand the difference between a mother-in-law and a mother; he has done a very dirty thing. Devendra says - When Sapna and Rahul left home, they both changed their mobile numbers. A few days ago, Sapna called. At that time, she was in the car, we talked for 2 to 3 days, but since our family members were angry with her, this contact was kept very limited. Rahul said - Did not marry, lived like husband and wife Rahul, who lives in Dado's Machhariya, said - I had not married Apna Devi; we were living like husband and wife. Black magic was performed on me. A black thread was tied on my foot. Living with Sapna was the biggest mistake of my life. I want to live a different life now. Sapna left me, that's okay, but now she should return my 2 lakh rupees, mangalsutra, ring, and mobile phone. Family also distanced themselves Rahul said that when he reached his village, Machhariya, after returning from Bihar, his family members refused to keep him at home. Currently, he is living outside the village, making ends meet. Wedding was to be on April 18, they ran away 12 days before Rahul says - Anita's daughter's wedding was scheduled for April 18, 2025. Before that, on April 6, Anita and I left Aligarh. We first went to Uttarakhand for some work, then came to the Bela area in the Sitamarhi district of Bihar. Here we rented a room. Got married in the temple. Rahul says - Sapna's family members started pressuring the police, then both of us voluntarily reached the Aligarh police station. People from both sides sat in one room, and after long discussions, it was agreed that the family would not trouble us anymore. We will live together. Sold clothes in Sitamarhi, fights started after 3 months We asked - When you left home, there were rumors that Anita was pregnant. To this Rahul says - Anita never got pregnant after our marriage; these are all baseless rumors. We asked - What did you do to run the household? Rahul says - We fell in love and got married. We didn't know anyone there, so I started selling clothes door to door. Some money started coming into the house, and everything was going well. We asked - So, when did the relationship turn sour? Rahul says - After 2 to 3 months, Anita started talking to her brother-in-law secretly. Gradually, her behavior also started changing. She started fighting with me over small things. I Money sent to sister's account, then she 'disappeared' We asked - Then what happened before dropping Anita home? Rahul says - About 5 days ago, Sapna asked to send 1500 rupees to her sister. I said I don't have money. After this there was a fight. After this, I first transferred 500 rupees, then 1 thousand rupees to her sister's account. Then everything was fine, but 5 days later Anita suddenly went 'missing' from home. Son-in-law said - Mother-in-law deceived, read the exact complaint Son-in-law Rahul filed a complaint at the Dado police station on Wednesday. In this, Rahul said - I work selling clothes by making rounds in Bihar. 15 days ago, my wife Anita contacted her brother-in-law. I have heard the audio recording of their phone conversation. In the audio, both were talking about living together. They had planned to poison me and run away together. On February 6, my wife Anita (previously mother-in-law) deceived me and left with her brother-in-law. She also took 2 lakh rupees in cash and jewelry with her. Therefore, my wife should be caught. Woman said - My decision turned out to be wrong After the case came to light in the media, Anita reached the police station on Thursday, February 12. She told the police - I left my children and went with my son-in-law. I deeply regret this now. Now I want to work and earn by living separately from Rahul. I want to live with my children, but Rahul has forbidden me from going to my children. Rahul beat me up, took away my jewelry and money. That's why I left him. The story of eloping with son-in-law from a year ago 1- Ran away with son-in-law 10 days before daughter's wedding Anita's first husband is Jitendra Kumar, and their daughter Shivani lives in the village Manoharpur Kayasth in the Madrak police station area. Jitendra had fixed his daughter's marriage on April 16, 2025, with Rahul, a resident of Riya Nagla village in Dado police station area. Rahul was a supervisor in a private company in Rudrapur, Uttarakhand. 10 days before the wedding, on April 6, 2025, Shivani's mother, Anita, suddenly disappeared from home. On the other hand, the groom-to-be, Rahul, also left his house, saying he was going to buy clothes, but did not return. As soon as they left Aligarh, both turned off their mobile phones. 2- After FIR was filed, surrendered at police station with son-in-law Family members searched extensively, but neither could be found. Five days later, Rahul called his father and said not to try to find him; he would not return. After this, Rahul's family learned that his mother-in-law-to-be was also missing. The family filed a complaint with the police. After this, the police conducted raids and search operations in several states, including Bihar. On April 18, both reached the police station and surrendered. Police took both into custody and interrogated them. 3- Refused to go to police station with husband, then started living with son-in-law Police tried to convince the woman and asked her to go with her husband, but she clearly refused. Anita said that she had been suppressing her desires for 20 years. She was mistreated over small matters. She could not tolerate all this anymore, so she left home. She said that she does not want to go with her husband now. After this, the police let both of them go. The woman had been living with her son-in-law since then.

stories.title: Devar-bhabhi caught on Chocolate Day:Duo murder husband and hang in Agra, family performs last rites considering suicide
stories.summary: “I had called my devar (brother-in-law) to celebrate Chocolate Day. Both of us were on the bed together. When my husband returned home and saw us, he became furious. That is why we had to kill him.” This is what a woman from Agra allegedly told police after she, along with her brother-in-law, murdered her husband. To make it appear like suicide, they later hanged the body. The family performed the last rites believing it was a case of suicide. The thirteenth-day ritual was being organised at home. During this, the women of the household grew suspicious of the wife’s behaviour. She did not appear grief-stricken. Instead, her attention seemed focused on her brother-in-law, Sundar. When the women questioned her and warned that the police could be informed, she broke down. Sundar’s mother later said she had no idea about the affair. “He used to speak on the phone at night. I didn’t know he was talking to his sister-in-law. He did wrong. He should not have killed. He will face punishment,” she said. Husband Lavkesh had returned home after a long day at work. He was tired. The door was not latched. As he was about to enter the room, he paused after hearing sounds from inside. Peering through the door, he allegedly saw his wife Gauri and his cousin Sundar together on the bed. Lavkesh became furious. However, mindful of family honour, he entered the room and angrily asked what was happening behind his back. Sundar tried to steady himself and looked towards Gauri. Both were frightened, knowing that once their affair became public, they would not be able to face society. Gauri pressed a pillow, Sundar held him down According to the police version, taking advantage of the tense moment, Sundar suddenly grabbed Lavkesh from behind and threw him onto the bed. To stop him from screaming, Gauri pressed a pillow over his face. Sundar held him down with force. Lavkesh struggled for about two minutes before going still. Afterwards, Sundar and Gauri sat on the floor near the bed, sweating despite the cold night. In another room, Lavkesh’s father, Suresh Chandra Tomar, was asleep. Sundar stepped out to check whether anyone had woken up and felt relieved to see his father still sleeping. They then decided to present the murder as suicide. Using a saree, they made a noose and tied it around Lavkesh’s neck. The other end was fixed to the fan hook, and the body was arranged to resemble a hanging. They adjusted his clothes and removed signs of struggle from the room. Relatives informed: ‘Lavkesh committed suicide’ By 2 am, everything was done. Sundar quietly returned to his own house, about 200 steps away. Gauri went to another room and pretended to sleep. At 6:30 am, Gauri began calling relatives, saying Lavkesh had committed suicide during the night. When his father entered the room and saw the body hanging, he believed it to be suicide. Gradually, friends and relatives gathered at the house. Neighbourhood women came and began mourning. Gauri sat among them. Sundar also joined the relatives, acting unaware. Even after the funeral, no one suspected foul play. Neither the police were informed nor was there any serious discussion. How Gauri was exposed On February 11, preparations were underway for the thirteenth-day ceremony. Women sat inside the house discussing why Lavkesh had taken such a step, especially as no suicide note had been found. While arrangements were being made outside, the women inside grew increasingly suspicious of Gauri’s behaviour. She did not seem visibly upset and appeared unusually attentive towards Sundar. The women informed a family member, and together they confronted her. They repeatedly asked what had happened on the night of February 9. Under mounting pressure and fear of police action, Gauri broke down and confessed that they had suffocated Lavkesh with a pillow and later hanged the body to stage suicide. Suresh Chandra then called the police. The saree used to make the noose was recovered from the house. Gauri was arrested from the home, while Sundar was arrested from a nearby market. Both have been sent to jail. What Sundar told police In custody, Sundar allegedly confessed. “On February 9 at around 11 pm, Gauri called me to celebrate Chocolate Day. Lavkesh usually returned home late, but that day he came early. That is how our affair was exposed. “Now I regret everything. I have lost both my love and my brother. The brother I grew up with is no longer in this world.” What the wife said... We didn't want to kill him, at that time we couldn't understand anything Gauri said in police custody - Lovekesh never misbehaved with me. Everyone at home is good people, Sundar is my brother-in-law, he is the son of my uncle-in-law Dharmendra Tomar. That's why there would be teasing incidents with him, he would also play pranks with me. Slowly I started liking all that. Our closeness increased. Sometimes he would come to my house, sometimes I would go to his house. Then one day Lovkesh read Sundar's messages on my phone. That's when he first became suspicious. On the night of February 9, Lovkesh went home early for this reason. We didn't want to kill him, but at that time we couldn't understand anything. Now know the village atmosphere People said - Sundar was from their family, so there was no suspicion After this incident, Dainik Bhaskar team reached Lodhai village in Ekta area of Agra. Here the villagers told that Lovkesh got married to Gauri on May 2, 2021. She is from Dholpur, Rajasthan. They also have a 3-year-old son. Villagers say - For a few months, Sundar was seen more with Gauri, but since he was a family member, who would suspect. Lovkesh was the only brother among 5 sisters in the house. After Lovkesh, whenever Gauri had to go somewhere, she would take Sundar along and he would do all her work there. Mother said - That 'murderer' will serve his punishment Sundar's mother Rekha Tomar says - No one knew that Sundar would do such a dirty thing. When he used to talk on the phone at night, I asked him many times who he was talking to, but he never told anything. He will serve punishment for whatever wrong he has done. All three of my sons work in electricity, the eldest brother works in electricity in Chandigarh and the second one in Guwahati. No one knew how long this had been going on between the two. After the incident, it was discovered that all this had been going on between them for four months. Brother-in-law said - Suspicion arose, how did she wake up at 4 AM when she usually wakes up at 10 AM We met Lovekesh's brother-in-law Sanjeev at home. He said - We received Gauri's call at 6 AM saying that Lovekesh had committed suicide. We were suspicious of Gauri because how did a girl who wakes up at 10 AM wake up at 4 AM that day? How did she find out first that Lovekesh had committed suicide? When she was asked about all this, she got nervous. After threatening to call the police, she confessed to the murder. Police statement Suspicion arose on the day of peace ritual, arrested and sent to jail DCP City Syed Ali Abbas says - Lovkush Tomar was married to Gauri 4 years ago. They have a 3-year-old child. Lovkush's father Suresh Chand Tomar works in Belanganj. On the morning of February 10, family members reported that Lovkush's body was found hanging from a fan. Thinking it was suicide, the family performed the cremation on February 10 itself. On February 11, there was a peace ritual at home. Family members became suspicious of Lovkush's wife Gauri's behavior. Family members began questioning her. What time did Lovkush go to sleep. Why did they fight. Police will come and investigate. Such conversations made Gauri very nervous. She confessed in front of family members that along with her cousin brother-in-law Sunder who lives in the village, she killed her husband and hung the body on the fan to make it look like suicide. Like her husband, Sunder is also an electrician.

Inequality, brutality, and dehumanisation have taken new forms in various workplaces, once again targeting the marginalised, with migrant workers added to the painful mix. The poor are still forced to work in inhuman conditions without wages and are subjected to verbal abuse and caste-based discrimination. On February 9, the Bonded Labour System (Abolition) Act will turn 50. Despite the Act and efforts to abolish bonded labour, Tamil Nadu still finds that the system of ‘modern-day slavery’ remains alive and kicking. While the State has made considerable efforts to rescue bonded labourers and file cases, delayed justice and inadequate rehabilitation continue to undermine the Act, pointing to the need for far stronger implementation, finds Meghna M.

stories.title: Noida woman shoots herself after discovering lover’s secret marriage:Brother accuses Delhi police constable of deceit, files FIR
stories.summary: My sister Priya and Ashish both wanted to get married. The family had also given their consent for the marriage. Later, my sister found out that Ashish was already married. When my sister asked Ashish about this, he started instigating her to commit suicide. On Thursday, Priya shot herself in the head with Ashish's licensed pistol. This is what Manish Kumar, brother of Priya, who committed suicide in Noida, said. Now, a photo has surfaced, which is said to be from Haridwar. In this photo, Ashish and Priya are both seen in bride and groom attire. Priya's hairline is also filled with vermilion. Ashish had secretly married Priya, but did not inform anyone about it. Read the complaint given to the police On the night of February 5, Priya, the girlfriend of Delhi Police constable Ashish, shot herself with a pistol. Ashish took her to the hospital in an injured condition, where she died during treatment. A post-mortem was later conducted. Priya’s brother, Manish Kumar, a resident of Kankarkhera in Meerut, filed a police complaint leading to an FIR. He stated that his younger sister Priya Singh was in a relationship with Ashish Panwar, and both wanted to marry, with the family’s consent. However, Ashish later began making excuses about the marriage. The family then learned that Ashish was already married. Manish alleged that when Priya confronted Ashish, he instigated her to commit suicide, after which she shot herself in the head with Ashish’s licensed pistol. Full incident details The case is from Radha Sky Garden Society in Bisrakh Kotwali. Constable Ashish, who had been serving in the Delhi Police for 5 months, and Priya (25) were living together in the society. They had been in a relationship for 5 years. Ashish was also involved in a divorce dispute with his wife. Was partying with friends Police investigating from every angle ACP Bisrakh said that the pistol involved in the incident has been recovered. The flat has also been sealed. The accused constable has been arrested. An FIR has been registered on the complaint of the family members and the matter is being investigated from every angle.

stories.title: GST officials use E-rickshaws to reach Sambhal market:Seize gold worth ₹33 Crore after leaving vehicles 1km away
stories.summary: On February 4, GST officials carried out a well-planned raid at a jewellery shop in Sambhal, seizing gold, silver and diamonds worth ₹33 crore. To ensure the operation remained confidential and no alert was raised in the market, the officers parked their vehicles nearly one kilometre away from the shop. The team then split into two groups and reached the market by e-rickshaws, entering Montu Jewellers while posing as customers. The investigation began inside the shop, during which no one was allowed to enter or leave for nearly two hours. It was only after four official vehicles and a police force arrived at the premises that news of the raid became public. The GST department conducted a 21-hour raid at Montu Jewellers, owned by Himanshu Agarwal, a resident of Mahajan Bisauli Gate in Chandausi. During the operation, gold, silver and diamonds worth ₹33 crore were recovered, for which the businessman reportedly failed to produce proper accounting records. The department has also recovered a penalty of ₹1.20 crore from the jeweller. See pictures GST team conducted surveillance for one month A GST department officer from Moradabad said - Our team surveilled the famous jeweler Himanshu Agarwal's Montu Jewelers shop for one month. After getting solid information, 10 officers reached Chandausi on February 4th. They left their 4 vehicles outside the city. Then at 1 PM, they reached the jewelry market by e-rickshaw. In this 21-hour operation, 16 kg 638 grams of gold, 875 kg of silver jewelry and 34.43 carat diamonds were recovered. This jewelry was not recorded in the stock register. The stock register only showed records of 439 grams of gold and 120 kg of silver jewelry. The value of the recovered jewelry was estimated at around 33 crore rupees. Information received about goods worth 300 crores According to sources, the GST department had received information about the jeweler possessing gold and silver jewelry worth more than 300 crore rupees. However, after the operation that continued throughout the night, the department could only recover jewelry worth 33 crore rupees. It is said that Himanshu Agarwal also invests in property business. He owns land worth crores. His business has been a topic of discussion in the market and the entire region for quite some time. He used to do wholesale business. Small shopkeepers would buy gold and silver jewelry from him. How was it planned? A GST officer said - Jewelers of Sambhal were being monitored for a month. For this, 15 to 20 officers would come from Moradabad to Sambhal in different teams. They would visit jewelry showrooms posing as customers. They would inquire about rates and gold stock. Some would keep watch on incoming and outgoing goods posing as security guards. Recently when gold and silver rates suddenly decreased, traders started buying more jewelry. As soon as Himanshu Agarwal, owner of Montu Jewelers in Chandausi's Bada Bazar, increased his stock, the team conducted the raid. Traders closed market in protest During the raid, other traders of Bada Bazaar protested by wearing black bands in opposition to the action. They had closed the market and sat on a dharna. They raised slogans against GST officials. On the morning of February 5 too, traders kept the market closed and sat on dharna outside shops. Trader Rajesh Jindal said - Due to inflation, business in the jewelry market has stalled. We are very troubled by this. This is the fifth raid in Chandausi. We should not be exploited like this, we should get facilities. BJP city president Ankur Agarwal and former Minister of State for Central Sanitation Commission Manju Diler had also reached the spot. They had talked to the traders. After assurance, the traders had ended their protest. After this, the market opened on February 6. Jeweler posts status amid protest Meanwhile, after the raid on February 6, jeweler Himanshu Agarwal wrote a message on social media - GST officials fully cooperated during the survey. We have not given any statement regarding any kind of misconduct. Local people are deliberately spreading fear and rumors in the market. This is completely wrong.

stories.title: UP Evening Wrap:Goyal says, 'No duty cuts on agri, dairy imports from US’; Mayawati meets party members ahead of polls more
stories.summary: Bhaskar English brings you the biggest updates from Uttar Pradesh and around the world. Here are the top news headlines of the day: 1. Goyal says, ‘No duty cuts on grain, fruit, dairy poultry imports under India-US interim trade deal’ India has gained a major trade edge after an interim deal with the US, Union Minister Piyush Goyal said. The agreement protects Indian farmers and MSMEs while opening the US market to products like red sorghum, tree nuts, wines, and spirits. No benefits will be extended to US agricultural imports. 2. Mayawati says ‘tighten your belts, Assembly elections are near’ BSP supremo Mayawati steps up preparations for the upcoming Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections, urging party leaders and workers to stay fully active. She alleges a conspiracy to weaken the party and holds a meeting with officials from all 403 seats. 3. AIMIM starts preparing for UP 2027 elections Asaduddin Owaisi’s AIMIM begins mobilisation for the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections. The party claims to have added over 10 lakh members in two months, bringing total registered members in the state to over 86 lakh. SP and Congress challenge Owaisi to convert numbers into public rallies and advocate for the oppressed. 4. US map shows PoK, Aksai Chin as Indian territory, image goes viral India and the United States on Friday announced the framework of an Interim Trade Agreement (ITA), following which the Office of the US Trade Representative (USTR) shared a map depicting the entire Jammu and Kashmir region, including Pakistan-occupied Kashmir (PoK) and Aksai Chin, as part of India. 5. 4 women caught in Prayagraj for egg extraction scam In Prayagraj, police act against a racket involving egg extraction from minor girls. Five people are in custody, including four women, a mother-daughter pair, an IVF agent, another woman, and a man. A minor girl was lured into IVF with an iPhone using false marriage documents. 6. 6 killed on Yamuna Expressway in Mathura Six passengers are crushed to death by a speeding container after stepping out of a sleeper bus on the Yamuna Expressway. One person is critically injured, and two others sustain injuries. The accident occurs early Saturday morning around 2:45 am. 7. Epstein files 'expose' Anil Ambani chat, offered a Swedish blonde New revelations related to Anil Ambani have emerged in the documents released by the US Justice Department concerning sex offender Jeffrey Epstein. These documents are related to conversations between Epstein and industrialist Anil Ambani that took place between 2017 and 2019. 8. ₹10 biscuit reel fame Shadab Jakati may face 10-year jail Social media influencer Shadab Jakati, famous for the line “₹10 wale biscuit ka packet kitne ka hai ji?”, faces legal trouble after a Meerut woman alleges rape and threats. 9. Window too narrow for three sisters to jump together In Ghaziabad, police investigating a triple suicide find it technically impossible for all three sisters to jump together from the same window. The finding comes after nearly five hours spent inside Flat No. 907, recreating the crime scene to determine the sequence of events. . 10. BCCI announces ₹7.5 crore prize money for U-19 Indian team BCCI will give prize money of ₹7.5 crore to the Indian team that won the Under-19 World Cup. BCCI Secretary Devajit Saikia announced the prize money on Saturday.

stories.title: UP sees semi-nude Brahmin protest against ‘Ghooskhor Pandat’:BJP Leader Aparna Yadav calls title insensitive
stories.summary: Tensions rise in Uttar Pradesh as protests erupt over the title of Manoj Bajpayee’s upcoming film ‘Ghooskhor Pandat’. In Agra, members of the Brahmin community staged a dramatic semi-nude demonstration, blowing conch shells to express their outrage. Protesters demand an end to what they call repeated insults to their social and religious sentiments. BJP leader Aparna Yadav said that making or writing such insensitive remarks, that too about a community which has kept Sanatan culture alive across the world, is not right. Bareilly-based cleric Maulana Shahabuddin Razvi demanded a ban on the film. Meanwhile, Union Minister of State for External Affairs Kirti Vardhan Singh said, A disgusting attempt has been made in the film to hurt the sentiments of the Brahmin community. The use of casteist and objectionable language and portrayal is condemnable and amounts to playing with the social fabric. Earlier, on Thursday, on the directions of the Chief Minister, an FIR was registered against the film’s director in Lucknow. Deputy Chief Minister Brajesh Pathak had appealed to the Centre to intervene in the matter. Later, the government directed OTT platforms to remove the title. Amid the protests, director Neeraj Pandey also decided to remove all promotional material of the film from all platforms. Know about the film The film ‘Ghooskhor Pandat’ is being directed by Neeraj Pandey and Ritesh Shah. The film stars Manoj Bajpayee, Nusrat Bharucha, and Shraddha Das in lead roles. Its teaser was released on February 3. The film will be released on Netflix later this year. In the teaser, Manoj Bajpayee is seen in the role of senior inspector Ajay Dixit, who is known as ‘Pandat’ in Delhi. In the film, he is portrayed as a notorious police officer. According to the teaser, Dixit was recruited as a sub-inspector 20 years ago. Due to his deeds, he was repeatedly demoted. At one point, he gets badly trapped while trying to save an injured girl, which changes his life. Neeraj Pandey is the same director who has made films like MS Dhoni: The Untold Story and Baby.

stories.title: Farmers create ruckus, Union Minister leaves press conference midway:Clash over slogans in Kashi; budget briefing disrupted
stories.summary: Union Minister Kamlesh Paswan walked out of the press conference in Varanasi. He had arrived at the Circuit House to discuss Modi government's budget presented on February 1. During this time, farmers protested. They raised slogans vigorously. They questioned about the compensation for land being acquired for Kashi Dwar Residential Scheme. The farmers surrounded the Union Minister. They came near the stage and started arguing. The minister had an altercation with them. The commotion continued for a long time. Seeing the situation deteriorate, Minister Kamlesh Paswan got down from the stage and left. Even after the minister left, the uproar continued. Local leaders called the police. Police took 10 protesting farmers into custody. Now let's understand the whole matter in detail... 'Government wants to acquire land from 10 villages' Farmers said that the government wants to acquire more than 800 acres of land from 10 villages in Pindra tehsil area. A high-tech colony is to be built on this land under the Kashi Dwar residential scheme. The Housing Development Council has completed surveys in 7 villages, but work is stalled in 3 villages due to farmer protests. Farmers questioned how compensation worth crores for the land is being given in lakhs. The DM circle rate has not been increased. Registry has been stopped. After losing our fields, we will now become useless. Due to not getting compensation at proper value, we are unable to buy other land. Farmers started presenting their case inappropriately ACP Cant Nitin Taneja said that the press conference program was scheduled in advance. During this time, some farmers protested regarding compensation and started presenting their case inappropriately during the press conference. Police tried to convince them to present their case peacefully, but despite this some people continued creating a ruckus. ACP Cant said that if any written complaint is received in this matter, action will be taken according to the rules.

stories.title: Minister Dinesh Pratap’s photo defaced with black ink, labelled ‘traitor’:Earlier branded Rahul as ‘fake Gandhi’ in Raebareli
stories.summary: Hoardings featuring Minister Dinesh Pratap Singh in Rae Bareli were defaced with black ink after they labelled MP Rahul Gandhi a “fake Gandhi”. The word ‘traitor’ was scribbled over the minister’s photograph. On Friday, the minister had installed hoardings at nine locations across the city. The posters labelled Rahul Gandhi a “fake Gandhi” and raised the question: Who is the traitor — real Sardar Ravneet Singh Bittu or fake Gandhi Rahul Gandhi? The Congress party had strongly objected to the hoardings, calling them provocative and inappropriate. See photos Parliament matter reaches Raebareli Outside Parliament on Wednesday, Rahul Gandhi described Union Minister of State Ravneet Singh Bittu as a “traitor”. A day later, during his address in the Rajya Sabha on Thursday, the Prime Minister, without naming anyone, accused Rahul Gandhi and his family of “stealing” Mahatma Gandhi’s surname. Two days after the controversy, hoardings were put up at nine locations across Rae Bareli at around 4:45 am on Friday. The Congress party protested against the move. UP Congress Committee Secretary Atul Singh told Dainik Bhaskar that the hoardings reflected a “petty mentality”. He said Rahul Gandhi was fighting for public interest against both the central and Uttar Pradesh governments, from Parliament to the streets, and claimed that the BJP would face defeat in the 2027 Assembly elections. The hoardings carried provocative slogans such as ‘Who is the traitor?’ and ‘Fake Gandhi Shri Rahul Gandhi’. Minister Dinesh Pratap Singh himself had shared images of these posters on his Facebook account, following which they were installed across the city. On Saturday, the same hoardings were defaced with black ink. The minister’s face was blackened and the word ‘traitor’ was written over his photograph. Read what's written on hoarding The hoardings feature a large image of Bharat Mata along with a photograph of Minister Dinesh Pratap Singh. On the left side of Bharat Mata’s image, the hoarding reads: “Real Sardar Ravneet Singh Bittu — betrayed by Congress; the faithful people of the entire country have left Congress (did Rahul Gandhi call him a traitor?) Mamata Didi (loyal?)” On the right side, it reads: “Fake Gandhi Mr Rahul Gandhi — betrayal of India, Indians, Indian culture and values; betrayal of Lord Ram, Sardar Patel, Subhash Chandra Bose, Dr APJ Abdul Kalam, Feroz Gandhi, Maneka Gandhi, and the Vadra family businessmen of Moradabad district in Uttar Pradesh.” Where the Hoardings Were Installed One hoarding each was installed at Nirala Nagar, Gandhi Nagar, Ekta Vihar Colony, Saras Hotel, Degree College intersection, Ratapur intersection, and along the National Highway at Tripula. In addition, two hoardings were put up at Didoli. Origin of the ‘Traitor’ Remark Congress leader Rahul Gandhi called Union Minister of State Ravneet Singh Bittu a “traitor” on Wednesday, February 4, during a protest outside Parliament near Makar Dwar in Delhi. During the protest, when Bittu approached from the front, Rahul Gandhi was heard saying, “My traitor friend is coming.” He then extended his hand for a handshake, which Bittu declined. Bittu responded by accusing Rahul Gandhi of acting against the nation’s interests and called him an “enemy of the country”. This led to a sharp exchange between the two leaders. Rahul Gandhi later remarked, “Don’t worry, my traitor friend, you will come back.” At the time, Ludhiana MP Amarinder Singh Raja Warring, Gurdaspur MP Sukhjinder Randhawa, and Amritsar MP Gurjeet Aujla were also present. Ravneet Singh Bittu later alleged that there was an attempt to assault him during the incident. Reacting to the controversy, BJP leader Manjinder Singh Sirsa said that “a Sardar is not a traitor”, and accused the Gandhi family of betraying the nation, referring to historical events linked to the Golden Temple. PM had said - Rahul stole Mahatma Gandhi's surname On February 5, PM Modi gave a speech during the motion of thanks on the President's address in the Rajya Sabha. During this, he made several major claims about Congress. He said - Pandit Nehru and Indira Gandhi considered the people of the country as a problem. Without naming names, the PM accused Rahul and his family of stealing Mahatma Gandhi's surname. Dinesh had lost election to Rahul, targeting since then Dinesh Pratap Singh is the Minister of State (Independent Charge) for Horticulture, Agricultural Marketing, Agriculture, Foreign Trade and Agricultural Export Department in UP government. In 2024, Dinesh Pratap Singh contested against Rahul Gandhi from Raebareli seat. Here Rahul Gandhi decisively defeated BJP's Dinesh Pratap by 3 lakh 90 thousand 30 votes. Rahul got 6 lakh 87 thousand 649 votes. Dinesh Pratap got 2 lakh 97 thousand 619 votes. Immediately after the defeat, he had said that I will now work only for the 3 lakh people who voted for me. For those who voted for Rahul Gandhi, now he should fulfill his responsibility for them.

stories.title: Mayawati says ‘tighten your belts, Assembly elections are near’:Alleges conspiracy to weaken party, holds meeting with officials from all 403 seats
stories.summary: BSP supremo Mayawati has stepped up preparations for the upcoming Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections, calling on party leaders and workers to remain fully active. Addressing a large meeting of the Bahujan Samaj Party on Friday, Ms. Mayawati asked officials and workers to intensify efforts for the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) and election-related work. She said only a limited time was left and urged everyone to enter the field with full preparation. Ms. Mayawati warned that attempts were being made to weaken the party and said workers and officials must stay alert against such conspiracies. The meeting was attended by state division presidents, in-charges of all 403 Assembly constituencies, and members of the party’s Brotherhood Committee. Issues discussed included organisational expansion, steps to increase public support, and a review of the party’s activities over the past year. What did Mayawati say in the meeting? Mayawati outlined the party’s priorities and issued clear directions to leaders and workers during the meeting. Strengthen the organisation Ms. Mayawati said the party must make its best efforts to expand its support base. Workers should reach out to people directly, speed up party activities, and strengthen the organisation down to the booth level through planned work. Work on every Assembly seat She said the party must remain active in all Assembly constituencies. Leaders in charge of each seat should work in their areas, increase public contact, and inform people about the party’s past work and future plans. Be alert to opposition moves Ms. Mayawati alleged that opposition parties were trying to weaken the BSP using various tactics. She asked workers to understand such attempts and remain cautious. Warning against politics of religion and caste She said efforts were being made to spread division in society through religion- and caste-based politics. Such actions, she added, were dangerous for democracy. Concern over Parliament deadlock Referring to the ongoing parliamentary session, Ms. Mayawati said both the ruling party and the opposition were focused on attacking each other instead of discussing public issues. She said Parliament’s rules should be strictly followed and criticised the lack of clarity on key issues such as tariffs, inflation, and employment, adding that public concerns were being pushed aside due to political confrontation.

stories.title: Clean, fragrant bedrolls to be provided on trains:Railways rolls out new linen loading system on 42 long-distance trains, no reuse of linen on return journeys
stories.summary: Passengers travelling on long-distance trains will now receive clean and fragrant bedrolls. Indian Railways, responding to repeated complaints from travellers, has made a significant change to the bedroll system. Under the new arrangement, used linen will no longer be issued on return journeys. Linen will be loaded from both starting and terminal stations The Railways has decided that bedrolls will now be loaded not only from the starting station but also from the train’s final station. This ensures that blankets and sheets used during the journey are not given to passengers again, and fresh, clean linen is available for every trip. Implemented in 42 trains in first phase In the first phase, this new system has been implemented on 42 long-distance trains across the country. This includes 10 major trains running through the Northeast Railway. Key trains include Asansol–Gonda, Lucknow–Chandigarh, and Jaynagar–New Delhi. Passengers will get better travel experience Railways says that this decision will not only improve cleanliness but also enhance the travel experience for passengers. Especially for those travelling at night, fresh bedrolls will provide significant comfort and relief.

stories.title: Brother, sister and aunt going for CTET exam die:Uncontrolled dumper runs over them in Hardoi, bodies scattered on road
stories.summary: In a tragic road accident on Saturday in the Sursa police station area of Hardoi, three people, including a brother and sister, died on the spot after being hit by an out-of-control dumper. All three were riding a motorcycle while returning to Hardoi. The bodies are left strewn across the road. The deceased have been identified as 20-year-old Adarsh Awasthi and his 23-year-old sister Madhu Awasthi, residents of Fatiyapur, and Kamini Pandey from Bawan Chungi, who was their aunt. The trio was riding a motorcycle (UP 30 CA 5328) toward Hardoi when the accident occurred. See 4 pictures of the accident... The accident took place near Dholia Chauraha, close to Farm Purwa in the Sursa area. A dumper coming from the opposite direction (UP 30 CT 6385) collided violently with the motorcycle. The impact was so severe that all three victims died instantly at the scene, despite wearing helmets. Bodies are left scattered across the road, creating chaos at the accident site. Sursa police reached the spot immediately after receiving information. The bodies were taken into custody and sent for postmortem at the district hospital. The dumper involved in the accident has also been seized by the police. The news of the accident plunged the families of the deceased into grief. The police have launched a search for the dumper driver, who fled the scene. Local authorities have ordered a thorough investigation into the incident. Adarsh worked in Delhi, Madhu was preparing for competitive exams Father of the deceased Adarsh, Arvind Awasthi, said he earns a living through farming. His younger son Adarsh worked at a factory in Delhi. On Friday, he had come home on leave to attend his cousin’s examination. For the same programme, his sister-in-law Kamini Pandey had also come to Fatiyapur. Madhu was preparing for competitive examinations and had her CTET exam scheduled on Saturday. Adarsh had left on a bike to drop his aunt at her in-laws’ house and take his sister for the exam, but the tragic accident occurred on the way. Sursa police station in-charge Sunil Kumar Mishra said that 3 members of the same family riding a motorcycle died after being hit by a dumper. The dumper has been seized and a search is on for the driver. The matter is being investigated and legal action will be taken.

stories.title: 4 women caught in Prayagraj for egg extraction scam:Minor girl lured into IVF with iPhone using false marriage documents, accused under police custody
stories.summary: In Prayagraj, major action has been taken in a case involving the extraction and sale of eggs (ova) from minor girls. Police have taken five people into custody, including four women allegedly involved in the racket. The accused include a mother-daughter pair, an IVF agent, another woman, and a man. The accused allegedly trapped a minor girl by offering her an iPhone and ₹10,000, and then took her to an IVF centre, claiming she was married. There, the minor’s eggs were extracted. The girl’s mother had filed a complaint about the matter on 6 February. Following the complaint, the police took into custody the victim’s neighbour Rinki, her daughter Palak alias Zoya, Seema Bharti, Himanshu Bharti, and Kalpana Bharti. Earlier investigations also revealed the involvement of a Muslim woman in orchestrating the racket. Police are tracing her and examining the case from three angles: The case falls under the Phaphamau police station area. Let's first understand the entire matter... Now know how the arrest happened... DCP Ganga Nagar Kuldeep Gunawat said that after Shalini’s complaint, the police first arrested Rinki and Palak. During questioning, they revealed that they had taken the girl to Seema Bharti (wife of Dileep Bharti). Seema then had her son, Himanshu, create a fake Aadhaar card for the minor, making her appear adult and married. Using these fake documents, Seema handed the girl over to Kalpana Bharti, a registered IVF agent. Kalpana then prepared a fake consent affidavit. Using the fake Aadhaar card and consent affidavit, the IVF centre performed egg extraction on the minor. Based on this, the police took Rinki, Palak, Seema, Himanshu, Kalpana, and another accused into custody. Commission from 30 to 35 thousand rupees DCP Kuldeep Singh Gunawat said- Police investigation revealed that a commission of about 30 to 35 thousand rupees is given for one client. The scam was running because of the commission. More people's involvement may come to light in this. Police are also investigating the role of other agents of the IVF center as well as other people. FIR will be filed against everyone and they will be sent to jail. Investigation ongoing into how many girls trapped in racket Child Welfare Committee (CWC) Chairman Akhilesh Kumar Mishra said- Information about the girl was received through Child Line. The girl has been kept in a shelter home. It is clear that the girl was brainwashed and operated on to extract eggs. The girl's statements also revealed attempts to persuade her to adopt Islam. We are investigating how many girls are trapped in this racket.
